All of that makes it not just one of the best JRPGs on the market today, but one of the best games hands-down.

Tales of Arise is a successfully comeback story. It’s definitely one of the most refreshing Tales game and probably one of the best JRPGs launched in 2021. I’m not sure if Bandai Namco planned to make the Tales franchise mainstream, but that’s something that Tales of Arise manage to achieve, and that’s probably the best compliment I can give the game. My only concern is related to how Bandai Namco

Tales of Arise went above and beyond our expectations. With its picturesque landscapes instilling a real sense of adventure, it's easily one of the strongest, most cohesive Tales games to date. Dramatic cutscenes and memorable character moments help sell an intriguing story, while a satisfying combat system becomes more and more engaging as your party powers up. A fantastic, modernised journey wit
Tales of Arise is a great game and a significant step forward from its predecessor, a wonderful mix of bright narrative and excellent gameplay.

Bandai Namco created something special here. Fast-paced, accessible combat meets a well-constructed narrative told with beautiful visuals, wonderful voice work, and an impeccable soundtrack. Even with its odd issue here and there, nothing stands in the way of Tales of Arise succeeding on all levels.

Tales of Arise is a triumph in almost every way, delivering a strong narrative, well-developed characters, and combat that feels snappier than ever. This is the next step in the evolution of the Tales series, and the future looks awfully bright.

s.desc:
众人热爱的丧尸传奇回来了，并带来恐怖、黑色幽默与夸张的丧尸砍杀调制而成的独特配方，贯串一场史诗级的低俗冒险。
《Dead Island 2》是款刺激的第一人称动作角色扮演游戏，时尚、有活力并且尸满为患。探索遍地血污的经典洛杉矶风光。认识非凡的角色。砍杀无数敌人，欣赏精致的血液细节。然后进化成终极丧尸杀手！
立即预购即可取得班诺伊回忆包，内含两种独家武器、一种特殊武器加成与技能卡。
欢迎来到洛杉矶地狱
有个致命的病毒正在洛杉矶四处传染，将宿主转变成饥饿的丧尸。您被咬、遭到感染，但得到了超乎免疫的能力；揭开传染爆发背后的真相，查明自己究竟是谁…或者是什么东西。存活、进化，并拯救世界吧！
游戏特色
探索洛杉矶地狱：《Dead Island 2》将带玩家跨越天使之城最具代表性的地点，只是如今处处都染满恐怖；您将在比佛利山翠绿郊区、威尼斯海滩的奇异步道等地展开惊奇的低俗冒险。
残暴的近战沙盒：战斗系统带来激烈、血肉横飞与暴力程度达到极限的第一人称体验，有多种武器与战术 (以及暴力) 选择，能在尸群中开出一条路。无论斩击、敲击、燃烧或撕裂，我们都希望您杀得真正有感。
成为终极丧尸杀手：有六名角色可选择，每一名都有各自的独特性格与对话。您可以完全自定义每一名杀手的能力，利用全新的技能系统让您立即重新分配能力并试出最疯狂的组合。
丧尸泛滥：准备好体验游戏界最先进的肢解系统了吗？我们的洛杉矶到处都是有写实外观与反应的丧尸。这些变异怪胎就是《Dead Island 2》复生腐烂的核心要角，有数十种独特的丧尸种类，每一种都有各自的变异、攻击方式与数百种洛杉矶主题的造型变化。我们的怪物无情、高强，而且是真正的洛杉矶人。您能幸存下来吗？
电影风格合作冒险：《Dead Island 2》是一款正统的角色扮演游戏，提供大量刺激任务、破天荒的角色，以及惊险的低俗剧情，让您真正沉浸在扭曲的世界观中。保证百玩不腻。另外还有精彩夸张的合作模式，最多可以三名玩家进行，保证让您能在洛杉矶度过一段十分长久 (并且暴力) 的旅程。
使用 PS5 和 PS4 Pro 主机的玩家可以主办并加入合作游戏。PS4 玩家可以加入合作游戏，但是由于技术限制，所主办的游戏只能供一名玩家加入。

critic.quote: Throwing out the dour and the drab, Dead Island 2 is all about killing in style. From the beautifully rendered wastelands of HELL-A, to the equally visceral limb destruction system, there’s endless fun to be had here. With enough to do solo or with friends/strangers, not to mention the upcoming expansions, Dambuster Studios have rewritten how to enjoy oneself in the face of Armageddon.

A delightfully gory surprise, Dead Island 2 rises above its hellish development to deliver the sort of horror comedy romp that is rarely seen in the industry. It doesn't break the mould, but it does deliver pure blood-soaked campy joy from start to finish.
Dead Island 2 does not fool you into thinking it's another deep virtual drama or an epic RPG. It's simply a great action comedy designed to make you relax, provided you like bloody hordes of zombies.

Dead Island 2 is a classic zombie-themed action game that offers hours of fun in its amusing brutality, with thousands of undead to slay in the most creative ways and a collection of weapons suitable for every need. However, the lack of originality limits the potential of a gaming experience that doesn't shine in terms of story and mission variety. Fighting zombies from Beverly Hills to Santa Moni
Zombie hacking at its purest, Dead Island 2 takes some simple ideas and works them to perfection in a well-made and fun game. It's a one note thrill, but does well to make that note absolutely sing.

Dead Island 2 is very much so a blast from the past. It looks pretty, but it’s a phoned-in first-person action zombie adventure with oddly unpolished combat, horrendous writing, and overly linear stages that lack depth.

s.desc:
鬼武者系列完全新作！
本作是刀光血影、以牙还牙的极致动作游戏。
这次的舞台设在日本江户时代初期的“京都”，
历史悠久的都城因瘴气而面目全非。
形形色色的关卡无一不充满了诡异气息。
来自异界的恐怖“幻魔”，和苟延残喘的人们，共同交织出一幕幕黑暗的奇幻故事。
而在这京都之内，一位佩戴“鬼之笼手”的武士正四处奔波，斩杀猖獗肆虐的幻魔。
在激烈的刀光剑影之中沐浴鲜血，不断寻求战斗的意义。
前行的道路，终将通往何处？
本作品的主角──宫本武藏。
血气方刚的武者，为在剑道上登峰造极而现身京都。
但其修行之路，恐会无比曲折离奇。
Capcom在塑造“宫本武藏”时，为了使这位武士的形象更加深入人心，
参考了世界知名的武士演员——三船敏郎，作为角色形象。
本作所描绘的主角年盛气强，是一位在腥风血雨中奋战，在泥泞中前行的武士。
动作
宫本武葳获得的鬼之笼手拥有着异于常人的力量。
笼手除了能够讨伐幻魔，还能吸收敌人释放出的灵魂，根据灵魂种类可获得不同的效果。
从笼手中传来一把声音，究竟是谁？
幻魔
本盘踞在地狱深处的残暴怪物，如今却现形于瘴气弥漫的京都之中。
幻魔残虐不仁，穷凶极恶，让整个京都人心惶惶。
强敌
接连向武藏发动攻势的各路强敌。
其实力无比高强，绝非那些在街头巷尾撒野的一般幻魔所能比拟。
杀，抑或是被杀——
刀光血影、以牙还牙的死斗，将在京都这个舞台上不断上演。
舞台
本作的舞台是以清水寺为首，神社和佛寺林立的京都。
受瘴气的侵蚀而变得诡异和不可思议。

critic.quote: Onimusha: Way of the Sword isn't just an excellent series revival from a company that has seemingly mastered them, taking a proper understanding of the early entries' appeal and matching it perfectly to modern sensibilities. It's also just plainly the best action game this year, and probably for the past few years.

Onimusha's return was significant in its own right. But the real value of Way of the Sword lies in the fact that it doesn't simply bring the Onimusha name back. Capcom understood what made the series so beloved and has blended those qualities with the evolution of modern action game design.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword is a fantastic return for a franchise many thought Capcom had left behind. Even when I thought combat had hit its peak, the game kept layering on deeper mechanics, richer upgrades, and thrilling boss encounters that demand your absolute best. In a stacked month of massive releases, Musashi’s journey isn't just worth your time—it's an absolute must-play for action fans.

Capcom forges a new katana with Onimusha: Way of the Sword, successfully reinventing the samurai saga for modern times. There is room for improvement, but if this marks the beginning of a second life for the Oni warriors—and we hope it does—it is a great first step along the path of the samurai.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword is a spectacular, challenging samurai action game that will put your reflexes to the test in a ruthless way. It isn’t a ‘soulslike’, but it draws on some of its principles to create electrifying combat.

Way of the Sword clearly aims to be a modern take on old-school Onimusha: dark, bloody, linear, and cinematic - and it absolutely succeeds. Rather than chasing open worlds and hundreds of hours of content, it focuses on a brilliantly designed combat system and dynamic, brutal encounters. And sometimes, that’s more than enough.

critic.quote: Monster Train 2 doesn’t just earn its place in the crowded roguelike deckbuilder genre—it sets a new bar. From the intense, multi-layered combat to the unforgettable art and music, every part of the game feels purposeful and polished. It’s rare to find a sequel that not only stands alone but also pushes the genre forward in such a confident, satisfying way.
An all-time great deckbuilder gets a sequel worth risking God’s wrath for.

Monster Train 2 is a roguelike deckbuilder par excellence. Its design makes it clear that developer Shiny Shoe has a deep understanding and love of what is so enthralling about this particular subgenre and doubles down. It’s carriage after carriage of big numbers, satisfying combos, dizzying synergies and new tactical possibilities that have kept me tied to the tracks for dozens of hours already,

Monster Train 2 is a well-crafted roguelike deck-building game that, even at launch, already provides a solid foundation for delivering the kind of gameplay fantasy most players are looking for. While the genre might not appeal to everyone and could be challenging for some, the game boasts an impressive level of polish and quality.

Monster Train 2 can end your social life in an instant because it is so fun, challenging and addictive. The many new features may not be particularly innovative, but they still manage to make this sequel a must-have roguelike deckbuilder for any fan of the genre.

So while Monster Train 2 can initially seem more like an expansion than a sequel, it favours potency over a reimagining of the basics, using trusted design as a basis for even more excessive combat creations. It's all about bigger, weirder kinds of damage. If, that is, you're prepared to think like a mad scientist. [Issue#412, p.118]

s.desc:
各种凶狠、恐怖的魔怪遍布于路易斯安那的沼泽地，而您身为老练赏金猎人团的其中一员，受雇消灭这些骇人的鬼怪，让他们永远从这个世界上消失。只要把魔怪逐出我们的世界，就可获得丰厚的赏金，并有机会购买更强大、更加凶残的武器。但若失败，您的角色和装备都会在死后灰飞烟灭。您的经验值则会保留在您的猎人池中——也就是您的 "血脉" 中——永不消散。
高风险、高回报、高紧迫感
《Hunt：Showdown》的高竞争性竞技式玩法结合 PvP 和 PvE 中的元素，在游戏中打造独一无二的紧张气氛，让您无时无刻不提防着自己的生命、角色和装备，以免它们灰飞烟灭。每场赏金猎杀竞赛开始时，最多可有 12 位玩家出发追寻魔怪目标。根据您选择的游戏模式和团队选项，这 12 人中既有单打独斗的玩家，也有二、三人一组的小队。魔怪一旦被寻获并消灭后，玩家就可获得一份赏金，但也将立刻变成地图中其余猎人的目标。一不留神，就会遭人伏击，眼巴巴地看着赏金被夺走，慢慢死去。风险越大，回报也越大。走错一步，万事皆空。
快速竞赛模式的比赛时间更短，期间最多有十位独立的玩家展开角逐，搜集装备，找到并关闭四个裂隙，同时彼此竞争，抢夺不断减少的赏金。率先抵达最终裂隙的猎人可以吸收裂隙的能量，但必须在最终倒计时中存活下来，才能完成任务。同时，率先抵达的猎人还要提防其他觊觎赏金的猎人。计时结束后，胜者可以保留自己的猎人，其余的人则尘归尘、土归土。
游戏进程
即使面临死亡，您也可通过您的血脉，维持并传承您猎人的等级进度。若您的猎人死去，其经验将会转入您的血脉，并可传承到您的其他猎人身上。要是您能成功逃出，就可以使用所赚到的钱财和经验招募新猎人，准备下一场竞赛。如果您死去，除了经验值以外，您将失去一切。
黑暗视域
黑暗视域让猎人们看穿各个世界之间的神秘纱帘，看到常人所看不到的事物。在追踪魔怪时使用黑暗视域，让鬼火带领您到达您下一个目标。黑暗视域也会标记握着赏金的猎人，使他们在逃跑之时更容易遭到他人的埋伏。

It's still a good game, but its short length and lack of ambition mean that it will constantly be seen as the lesser sibling. The addition of the REsistance online mode should add some value for those who enjoy competitive online play, but the lack of single-player options is disappointing. All in all, it's
Despite being a title of undoubted breadth, this remake of Resident Evil 3 could have reached a certainly higher quality level.

With Resident Evil 3, Capcom again succeeds in delivering a game that, as a remake, is nearly flawless. The problem is that the original game it is based on was never so great in the first place. critic.quote: So prepare your wands, put on your wizard robe and start exploring this incredibly magical world of Hogwarts which is an amazing homage to Harry Potter universe which set the bar so high, that not even Levioso could put other games on the same level.

As we near the end of this review, I have a small secret. I'm not someone you'd call a "fan" of the Wizarding World, at least not in the sense where I've got my own wand or want to down a butterbeer. I enjoy and appreciate the world that was built and the characters in it, but it's not like I got fully sucked in. That changed a little after a few dozen hours of playing Hogwarts Legacy. If you're a

Hogwarts Legacy is the game Harry Potter fans have dreamt of since the first book was released. It puts you firmly in the shoes of a student and turns you loose to find your place in the world of wizardry. Unfortunately, its biggest issue is that it often feels like you’re just visiting.

Hogwarts Legacy is an experience of mammoth proportions, really difficult to summarize in a few words. A meticulous reproduction of Hogwarts, its intricate labyrinths, its infinite secrets, is accompanied by a rich and multifaceted game structure, which will make you feel like real Hogwarts students for the first time. The game is to all intents and purposes what a Harry Potter fan has always drea

Whether you’re a diehard Potterhead or casual Wizarding World lover, you’ll have an epic time no matter what level of fan you are. Even though there is optional padding, it’s optional nonetheless. The core experience of Hogwarts Legacy is still not only the best game in the entire franchise but a seriously fun RPG that will take your breath away in its pinnacle moments.

The chips might have been stacked against them, but Warner Bros. and Avalanche Software have delivered on their promise. Hogwarts Legacy is the game that fans have been waiting for, laying down a solid foundation to build off of moving forward.

s.desc:
一般版内容：
·地球再次变四方？！ 数码方块地球防卫军2（PS4®＆PS5®）
游戏说明
地球变得四分五裂？怎么又来了！再加把劲拯救地球吧！
●巨大敌人蜂拥而至
大批巨大敌人接连袭击四四方方的地球。从巨大蚂蚁、巨大蜘蛛、巨大蜜蜂、巨大蝎子、巨大UFO、巨大机器人、巨大怪兽……甚至还有巨大外星人和巨大EDF士兵，让人陷入绝望。不过也正因如此，连续不断打倒敌人所带来的快感绝对是独一无二的。
●创建你自己的EDF部队
救出散落在世界各地的队员，并让他们成为伙伴，再从收集到的伙伴中选择四人组成队伍。根据你的战斗方式组建部队，决定装备后就出发吧。能收集的伙伴超过100人！
●历代兵种齐聚一堂
不仅有EDF的正统系列作，还有出现在衍生作品中的兵种也齐聚一堂。那些令人怀念的士兵，以及从最新作《地球防卫军6》中登场的士兵都在本作中登场。可装备的武器和配件超过600种。
●熟悉的敌人也将出现！
过去曾危害地球的侵略者们也将跨越世界线参战。玩家们熟悉的敌人都被重新设计成像素方块风格，还会有许多新敌人登场。游戏中共准备了100种以上的任务和5种难度等级。
●支持在线协力游玩＆本地分割屏幕游玩
支持最多4人的在线协力游玩。此外，仅限PS4®版和PS5®版支持分割屏幕游玩。与家人和朋友一起保卫地球吧。
～故事～
击败侵略者黑暗军团后，四四方方的地球好不容易重获和平，如今却又再次变得四分五裂。
当大家都抬头望向天空提防来自太空的敌人时，没想到却是从地底冒出的巨人盖亚克粉碎了地球。
身为曾经拯救地球的传奇指挥官，请再次指挥作战，拯救地球吧。
不管是圆的还是方的，只要是地球就是EDF的防卫对象。好了，出击吧！

critic.quote: World Brothers 2 provides excellent upgrades to mechanics from the first game to make this one feel even better to play.

I’m absolutely a fan of the spin-off, with World Brothers 2 carrying on the quick, accessible, and nonsensically entertaining action of its predecessor. It’s packed full of fun toys, drowns the player in content, and you can play as a woman who thinks she’s a horse.  She spawns carrots behind her when she sprints. How is that not what videogames are all about?

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is a bit of a mixed bag. It probably has the best gameplay in the series, but loses some of the scope and campiness of the mainline games. Also, the timing of its release is weird, coming out only 2 months after Earth Defense Force 6. While I reviewed the PS5 version of World Brothers 2, and found it ran beautifully, at the time of preorder, the Switch version

In a series that is quickly running out of fresh ideas, World Brothers 2 leans into being fast, fun and cheery. It might struggle to find an audience with both casual players and hardcore EDF fans but it certainly offers up some enjoyable alien blasting action.

While it's not all that different from its predecessor, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 proves to be a worthy follow-up, offering more missions and more Brothers to collect, and ultimately just being more fun in general. Whether you're an existing fan of the series or want a fun way to dip your toes into it, World Brothers 2 is easy to recommend.
World Brothers 2 is a great introductory title for those new to EDF, as well as longtime fans looking for a more straightforward experience that allows for quicker experimentation.

s.desc:
新特工、新威胁、新史诗战役
《Sniper Elite: Resistance》提供无与伦比的狙击机制、潜行和第三人称战术战斗，将这一获奖系列的关注点转向了一场远离前线、深入被占领的法国腹地的隐秘战争。
在与《Sniper Elite 5》并行展开的扣人心弦的新故事中，特别行动执行处(SOE)的特工哈里·霍克首次担任主角，他发现了一种阴险的新型奇迹武器——这种武器威力强大，足以确保纳粹赢得战争。
与法国反抗军合作，势必摧毁帝国武器库中的这一致命武器。
多个暗杀名单目标以及不同的潜入和撤离点为你提供了无与伦比的选择权，让你自由决定如何完成目标并创造出自己的游戏风格。
整个战役也可以在合作模式下进行。与盟友一起对抗纳粹战争机器，分享武器、物品和战术知识，并在交火中倒下时互相帮助重新投入战斗。
逼真的X射线击杀镜头和先进的枪战物理效果
标志性的X射线击杀镜头回归，展示每一次标志性射击的真实破坏力。骨头会使子弹偏转方向，不可预测地从新的路径穿透敌人的身体，而冲锋枪和手枪也会触发击杀镜头，以夸张的慢动作展示多发子弹射击。
要成功击中目标，你需要像真正的狙击手一样思考。在瞄准目标时，要考虑步枪枪托和枪管的选择，同时还要考虑重力、风和心率。
真实的二战武器和自定义
你可以使用的武器库将包括回归的系列游戏热门武器，以及一系列全新的二战真实武器。挑选合适的装备对于粉碎帝国的邪恶计划至关重要！
根据你的作战风格自定义武器。找到分散在战役各处的工作台，以使用新瞄准镜、枪托、枪管、弹匣等自定义和升级你的步枪、副武器和手枪。同时要记得为正确的任务选择正确的弹药，无论你需要的是穿甲弹还是非致命击倒。
宣传任务——加入反抗军
在主战役中找到独特的宣传海报，并在全新的宣传任务中扮演一名法国反抗军战士的角色。在这些情景中，潜行、狙击和击倒敌人，以完成限时任务，并帮助结束纳粹的占领。
轴心国入侵模式
广受喜爱的轴心国入侵模式回归了！以轴心国狙击手的身份入侵其他玩家的战役，参与致命的猫捉老鼠游戏。无论你是跟踪猎物、设下埋伏还是在枪林弹雨中奔跑，入侵的威胁都会为战役带来全新的挑战维度。
紧张的在线多人游戏
当你掌握了步枪后，自定义你的角色和装备，在竞争激烈的16人战斗中在线作战，以赚取经验值、奖章和勋带。
如果你不喜欢竞争，还可以在生存模式中与最多3名其他玩家组队对抗一波又一波的敌人。

critic.quote: Sniper Elite: Resistance is here, and it's not reinventing the wheel. It is the same craft that we've seen, with a more cheerful protagonist, in different locales. But that's not a bad thing, as Rebellion have only striven to improve the head-popping formula that they clearly care about. Another trip back behind enemy lines, Resistance is just as fun as any of the Sniper Elite's before it.

Sniper Elite: Resistance delivers more of the excellent tactical stealth shooting action that Sniper Elite 5 boasted three years ago. It might be a familiar experience, but for genre fans, it's still an easy recommendation.

Packed with that familiar caliber of intriguing level design and emergent gameplay, Sniper Elite: Resistance may not be the most radical of changes, but it undoubtedly makes up for it in its retaining the series’ joyous curating of tactile shots and careful planning alike.

Sniper Elite: Resistance is a reasonable continuation of the franchise, its sniping highs remain as amusing as ever thanks to some neat environmental gameplay, but much of its content rehashes what came before instead of evolving the series concept for a true next-gen sequel.

Resistance doesn’t introduce any major innovations, but it once again delivers a solid mix of action and mission planning, which is the Rebellion’s winning formula. However, the series can no longer rely solely on its signature cinematic kills to stay relevant. A general refresh, including technical improvements, is becoming necessary before the franchise risks slipping into a nostalgic more of th

Sniper Elite: Resistance serves as more of a stopgap than a full-blown sequel to Sniper Elite 5, so much of that experience — including its highs and lows — carries over two and a half years later. Its sniping action truly is elite, but the gunplay surrounding it still needs work. Equally, the Invasion Mode is again a standout while enemy AI remains frustrating at times. It is more of the same. s.desc:
通过重装上阵版和免费的《猩红纽带》DLC，获得更为丰富的《消逝的光芒2 人与仁之战》体验。请注意：DLC必须单独下载。
距离第一部游戏的故事已经过去了20年，病毒占了上风，人类正逐渐走向灭亡。你将扮演艾登·克拉德威尔，一个流浪漫游者，负责运送货物和传递消息，在被丧尸病毒摧毁的荒芜世界中，保持着与仅存的几个生存者聚居点的联系。然而，你的真正目标是找到妹妹米娅。为了逃离华尔兹医生的痛苦实验，你曾经离开了还是孩童的她。这段过去一直在你心中挥之不去。当你听说米娅可能还活着，并且居住在地球上最后一座城市维勒多时，你终于下定决心直面这一切。
不久后，你发现自己身处一个冲突不断的定居点。你需要参与新奇而残酷的战斗，不断磨砺自己的技能，击败成群的丧尸，并与其他人结盟。你将在城市中漫游，在维勒多的建筑和屋顶上自由奔跑，搜寻偏远地区的战利品，并在夜晚时保持警惕。每当太阳西沉，怪物就会占领所有街道。
末日后的世界
15年前，人类经历了一场大陷落，这场灾难永远改变了世界。到了2036年，只有为数不多的定居点存留于世，而人类正在逐渐走向灭亡，为无情的新物种——成群结队的丧尸——让路。
白天属于活人，夜晚属于感染者
白天，生存者仍然努力在这里生活，表面上看，一切似乎……不错。然而，当日落时分到来，一旦阳光消失，城市中更可怕的居民将占领街道。如果你在黑暗中停留太久，不提高警惕，就可能永远无法回家。
移动不止，生命不息
你不可能赢得所有的战斗。有时候，逃跑才是上策。幸运的是，你正好有这样的技巧。当你陷入危机，跑酷会让你顺利逃脱。在屋顶间跳跃，飞荡着穿过不同的城市景观等等。只要确保能够逃离夜晚的怪物。
残暴一点，再玩得花一点
在这个危险的世界中，只有最强者才能生存。无论你是喜欢粉碎、切割还是肢解任何挡在你面前的敌人，记得要发挥创造力！结合战斗和跑酷的方式抵御任何形式的危险，一切为了活命。
与其单打独斗，不如四个漫游者同行
有朋友相助，在维勒多活下去会更容易。与最多3名玩家组队，以增加你的生存几率。一起探索剧情，接受漫游者哨站的挑战，或是在城市街道上大肆破坏。

critic.quote: NBA 2K26 stands as the best entry in the series to date. Visual Concepts has further refined the gameplay, delivering greater realism and a more balanced reward system for the benefit of players. The WNBA plays a larger role in this installment, with expanded integration of both women’s and men’s basketball. MyTEAM feels more exciting than ever, while the new ProPLAY Motion Engine and rhythmic sho

NBA 2K26 is a release that stands out from previous editions and is definitely the basketball game the current generation has been needing for a long time. There's still plenty of room for improvement, but the work and development demonstrated this year confirms that there are solid foundations that, with some commitment, will result in better experiences for fans.

NBA 2K26 is the best installment in the series to date, and is probably the most comprehensive sports game on the market. It offers countless game modes, all powered by the revamped ProPLAY engine, which breathes new life into the gameplay and realism offered by the game. A must-have for all NBA fans who want to play with both current and past rosters, as well as the entire WNBA, which is coming t

NBA 2K26 continues to successfully live up to its reputation as “the best basketball game.” Yes, it may not introduce groundbreaking new features or modes, but it manages to take last year's good and make it even better.

NBA 2K26 hits the ground running as a complete and solid game in every respect, featuring a technical department up to the task, the series’ classic gameplay further refined and free of major flaws, and a substantial number of modes designed to keep you engaged with new content available at the start of each season, all the way until the next installment in the franchise.

NBA 2K26 is the best the series has offered in recent years in terms of gameplay and online content, and it’s a good starting point for anyone new who doesn’t mind the abundance of microtransactions and the slow progression.

critic.quote: Monster Hunter Rise delivers as the ultimate Monster Hunter experience. With an abundance of elements that make it uniquely related to the other games of the franchise, it also brings back the best in each entry, both in gameplay and in the roster of monsters. critic.quote: Nice to see another Assassin’s Creed game to explain yet another exciting story on another character, well done Ubisoft.

Assassin's Creed Mirage is an excellent homage to the past and a well-realized title in its own merits. Evoking elements that made the franchise a huge success and marrying them with several of the improvements made in recent games, it is a great game and it has a beautiful approach to telling the story of one of the most intriguing characters in the franchise: Basim.

Mirage is more of a tribute that a return to the classics, but the setting, the level design and the reasonable length are welcome changes to make Assassin’s Creed more enjoyable for the fans of the first games.

If you're a long-time Assassin's Creed fan that fondly remembers the early entries of the series, you're likely to love Assassin's Creed Mirage. Those who have found the last trio of entries simply too big will appreciate its sharper focus, too. While it does little to propel the series forward mechanically, it's a return to what made it stand out in the first place: an open world stealth game whe

Assassin's Creed Mirage recalls the chapters of the "pre role-playing" era with a certain effectiveness, with a system of notoriety that pushes you to return to anonymity with the means at Basim's disposal. Between the pleasant exploration of Baghdad - well characterized and equipped with the right amount of secondary activities - and interesting main missions, at least as regards level design and

Assassin's Creed Mirage sets off in search of its roots, and it finds them — both for better and worse. Undeniably basic in its approach to stealth and combat, it feels oddly dated in terms of design, but it's also a refreshing reminder of the series' original strengths. Ultimately, it's a solid sandbox title, and it successfully scratches the hidden blade itch that was so clearly absent in Odysse

Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 is a game of staggering scope, depth and complexity, allowing you to be a smooth-talking diplomat, a cunning craftsman, a sneaky cutthroat, a chivalrous knight in shining armour, or any combination of the above. Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 tweaks all the right rough edges of its predecessor without losing any of its character. The result is a fantastic role-playing game in which you can lose yourself for hours.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 isn't a game that should attract every kind of player, but even though you might have avoided the first part for whatever reason, you definitely should give the sequel a chance. It is a much more spectacular, bigger in every way mega-game that stands out from its peers.

Despite the noise, I think Kingdom Come: Deliverance II is a remarkable RPG that offers a role-playing style not often seen. It does everything that a sequel should do, polishing up the rough edges of the original game and improving the scope while making smart adjustments to the gameplay. It plays on the hubris of longtime players, but also guides newcomers with thematic objectives and a more explicit overall structure. s.desc:
在《从军》游戏中，玩家不仅能够操纵单名士兵在一线拼杀，更能指挥一整支小队达成战术目标——《从军》是一款多人在线小队射击游戏，忠实还原了风云激荡的 20 世纪多场著名战役的战斗情景。游戏中每场战斗的规模多达上百人，双方均有大量坦克与空战单位登场，打造独一无二的大战场体验！
率领您的部队，为胜利而战吧！
独特小队机制
玩家将指挥自己的小队投入战斗，除玩家直接操控的士兵外，小队内其他单位均由 AI 控制。即使出现伤亡，玩家也能立即切换至小队内其他士兵继续战斗。
独特的小队玩法让从军能够营造真正的大战场氛围，忠实还原了第二次世界大战一线战斗的烈度与强度！
真实战场环境
身临其境体验战火世界中多条战线上的历史战斗：从炮火连天的太平洋岛屿，到诺曼底登陆后肃清村庄；从柏林街头帝国最后的困兽犹斗，到保卫莫斯科最危急的时刻；从热战正酣的斯大林格勒到突尼斯的漫天黄沙……
第二次世界大战主要参战国中有 4 个国家在游戏内登场：美国、苏联、德国与日本。玩家可以选择加入任何一个国家，组建技能多样、职阶专长各异的小队为胜利而战。游戏根据战斗的真实交战方分配交战国家，不同国家的参战部队装备有阵营专属的武器载具，士兵外观也做到了真实还原。
多兵种联合作战
在步兵装备之外，《从军》还囊括了坦克、装甲车、摩托车等一系列地面载具，还包括战斗机与轰炸机的空中力量。多达 400款载具涵盖了绝大多数玩家耳熟能详的二战装备，驾驭这些钢铁巨兽迈向胜利吧！
此外，坦克手与机组成员不仅能够操纵技术兵器，也是受过战斗训练的优质战士——载具严重损毁、除了弃车逃生难道别无他法了吗？乘员组还可以拿起武器与步兵一起战斗，他们的战斗力也不容小觑！
胜利之路
游戏内士兵共分为 18 个职阶，不同职阶的士兵拥有专属技能树与武器装备，不仅涵盖了传统轻武器，还包括了各类重型技术兵器如可架设的反坦克炮、重机枪与防空炮；以及包括火箭发射器、火焰喷射器、枪榴弹在内的多款特种装备。无论何种作战情境都有破敌之道！
多种特殊机制极大丰富了游戏玩法：您既可以选择从敌人侧翼发动突袭，也可以选择作为空降兵伞降至敌方防线后方，或是使用工程兵在前线建造工事与机枪阵地固守。实现战术目标的手段多种多样，通向胜利之路永远不止一条！

A great idea that never quite reaches its full promise, Watch Dogs: Legion is still a cracking bit of techno fun. Come for the hacking and stay for the engaging story and cockney accents.

What players will find when picking up Watch Dogs: Legion is a game that is prepared for a long post-launch game-as-a-service experience. The additional DLC announced so far leans into the strengths of the game and established ideas that the series does well. The beekeepers, paintball guns and magician tricks all bring a sense of playful humour to the series, but it is worth noting that anyone who

critic.quote: Mortal Kombat 1 is a superbly presented fighting game with something to offer players of all experience and familiarity with NetherRealm's sprawling MK universe. The Kameo fighter system injects new strategic depth into combat, the rebooted timeline feeds a ridiculous story, and the suite of game modes are both varied and well made.

Fans waited four years for NetherRealm to release a new fighting game, and all that waiting paid off. From the surprises in its new mythology, to the white-knuckled pace and creativity in its gameplay, Mortal Kombat 1 is the freshest take on the series in years.

Mortal Kombat 1 is not a revolution but rather an evolution that
continues the franchise’s good streak. Excellent combat system, solid
story mode and some truly noteworthy additions (like Kameo or Invasion
Mode) make it really difficult to tear yourself away from the
controller. Sometimes you can feel that the series is starting to chase
its tail, but for now it’s hard to find a similarly acc

As a reboot, Mortal Kombat 1 is a complete success and the series has a colorful, sunny future thanks to the completely overhauled combat system, characters and aesthetics. If you look purely at the content and the way the modes have evolved, it is all a bit less impressive, but this is still a bold but successful new direction for the now classic franchise. It almost made me forget Injustice...

Mortal Kombat 1 is a reboot with a big, bloody heart. It re-tools Mortal Kombat’s story and characters in creative ways, and for the most part, the combat is excellent. Unfortunately, there are some elements that feel rushed. It’s still a very good fighting game, but it should have been a great one.

Mortal Kombat 1 serves as a love letter to fans of this thirty-one-year-old franchise and as a pseudo-reboot it also has potential appeal to newcomers alike. There's still room to grow and I'm sure it will just keep getting better, but Mortal Kombat 1 is already definitely worth your time.

critic.quote: I think Yakuza Kiwami, and the original game in general, had one of the best Yakuza plots in the series, and that holds true even today. The sole focus on Kazuma as the protagonist makes for a more focused adventure than Yakuza 4 and 5, and it’s nice to see how Kazuma builds his reputation as the Dragon of Dojima with this game. I’m also a sucker for betrayal/revenge plots, and the original Yakuza

Yakuza Kiwami is a worthy remake for the twisty, well-acted story alone and the fact that it is being sold at a cheaper price than current new release games is extra incentive to check it out. Combat is fun, the city feels live and there is so much stuff to do, from the mundane stuff like darts or shooting pool, to the very weird stuff like MesuKing, which is essentially rock paper scissors featur

Although understandable being just a remake and not a new entry, Yakuza Kiwami lacks the huge amount of content found in recent instalments of the franchise, but it does a great job updating the plot of the first entry in the franchise to later innovations and improvements, as well as current (although a bit dated) graphics.
Yakuza Kiwami presents the strongest mechanics in the franchise’s history, as well as refined side missions and lots of fun distractions that create a fantastic reimagining of a great game.
Quotation forthcoming.

critic.quote: Monster Energy Supercross 25 has truly won us over this year. While there are still some details that could use refinement in the future, the game arrives in great shape and shows strong potential for further improvement. The overhaul of the physics and dynamic system, for example, offers gameplay that feels well-suited to the current generation—though there’s still room for some visual enhancemen

Monster Energy Supercross 25 represents a step forward from previous titles. The progress due to the adoption of UE5 is evident and has brought the series even closer to a true simulation. Some adjustments are still necessary to better balance the difficulty level, correct sporadic problems with the opponent AI, and improve the navigability of the UI.

One the one hand Monster Energy Supercross 25 is undoubtedly the best series' entry so far with better graphics, better physics and more tracks than ever before. But on the other hand that still does not mean the game could fully compete with the top games of the genre, not least because of the lack of varied gameplay and modes. A solid racing game mainly for a special target group.

Taking a year off truly helped the core experience of Monster Energy Supercross 25, but at the sacrifice of cut content. The change to the Unreal Engine 5 provides a different experience than in the past. The updated riding physics makes the game both more accessible and more difficult. Tight cornering and fighting for grip is the biggest hurdle. The Neural AI in the fantastic Career Mode is great

Monster Energy Supercross 25 is a tough to pick up, but rewarding to learn racing sim. The new physics, courtesy of Unreal Engine 5, makes this iteration of the series more realistic than ever, with ever-evolving track surfaces that make every lap different and exciting with each new attempt. The career mode is nothing to write home about compared to most other modern sports or racing titles, and
Even If Monster Energy Supercross 25 shows some good intentions, it doesn't reach the standard of a Milestone productions yet.

踏上无与伦比的旅途——登上经过多重改造的蒸汽火车“曙光号”，与数名幸存者一起，在东方的土地上探寻新的生活。
体验沙盒式生存——动人心弦的故事，融合了经典地铁操作与全新的无边际关卡。
美丽但危机四伏的世界——探索后启示录的俄罗斯荒野，炫目的日夜循环和动态天气让自然环境变得栩栩如生。

critic.quote: Black Desert won’t be to everybody’s tastes, and does little to push the MMO genre forward. With that said, it does streamline the experience into a more familiar shell, its real-time combat and impeccable UI tweaks helping it fit onto a console with the minimal of fuss. Its quest structure is lacking in variation, and it doesn’t have the complex characters of The Witcher 3, but it’s a world that

Black Desert manages to surprise us with great features like its deep character editor and a very dynamic and varied combat system, with a rich world that's a pleasure to explore. On the other side, though, an overly complicated interface, some technical problems and a too repetitive mission structure keep it from reaching its full potential.
It’s cool to be the hero you were meant to become in a pretty world, but Black Desert is lacking in the meat of other classic MMOs and requires a hefty grind.

Black Desert could be an incredible MMO experience, but the lacklustre story, uninspiring quests, overly bland characters and the low difficulty of combat drag it down quite a bit. Should these drawbacks not deter you, then visiting its expansive and colourful world might be worth it.

Black Desert is a great MMORPG, but it needs more technical polish on Xbox One. Even on Xbox One X, it's far from perfect due to its lighting and performance problems. Unfortunately, it also lacks a lot of the content found on the PC version. Pearl Abyss has promised a series of updates which will bring over new regions and features, but it's unclear how long that will take.
It is easily the best of its kind to be found on the Xbox One and thanks to the tweaking and simplification of the combat for the system, it's a game that feels right at home on consoles.

critic.quote: The PlayStation 5 version of Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War is the best in the bunch. It tells a solid campaign with branching narrative choices, contains some of the best visuals that you’ve seen on a system not called ‘PC’, and it has some good, new faces on the multiplayer scene. Is it all perfect? Not at all, but it’s a good way for Call of Duty to start on the next generation of consoles.

Call of Duty Black Ops Cold War offers a familiar package: a too-short campaign developed by a reputable studio and multiplayer that provides lots of activities to score points, earn weapon unlocks, and shoot other players. Despite the length, the campaign is a fun departure from the Tom Clancy-esque tone of mainline games. It leans heavily into the aesthetic of the 1980s, from fashion to real-wor

Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War is full of content that series fans will enjoy and offers a few unexpected surprises along the way. Even if its particular themes aren't for you, it's tough to deny the amount of bang for your buck offered with this game.

Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War is a solid entry in the blockbuster franchise that looks stunning on next-gen consoles.  While its campaign fails to deliver on its potential, it still takes you on a thrilling tale of explosive espionage as you uncover the true identity of Perseus. Combine this with an old-school multiplayer component and expanded Zombies mode and you’ve got a shooter experience I

I have no doubt that the latest Call of Duty will earn ridiculous amounts of money once again, but I will remember it as a dip in form, a game that’s closer to mediocrity than greatness. The story campaign has a satisfying finale but as a whole is rather uninspired, while the multiplayer has lost the tactical feel I enjoyed in Modern Warfare Remastered. [01/2021, p.56]
I've never played a game more thoroughly unpleasant than Black Ops Cold War...

critic.quote: Aniimo is the next big thing. From the incredible creature designs to a world filled with life and magic, there’s just so much to enjoy. The monetization isn’t too bad, and there’s no gacha for the Ani

Even so, the game remains highly accessible.

Aniimo is a charmingly detailed live service game with a creature collection system, which is simple on the surface and as deep as the player wants to dive into it. Aniimo is a fun free-to-play creature collector with engaging real-time combat and quite a bit of content to explore. The creature design is fantastic, and the world is a beautiful space to explore. critic.quote: Overwatch 2 plays brilliantly. It’s a wonderful shooter full of depth, with unique heroes to master, maps to learn, and hours of your life to lose all over again.

Overwatch 2 is a worthy successor to the original Overwatch that doesn’t so much reinvent the wheel as it does improve upon it. While it does have its issues, the core gameplay and improved UI make for a fun and fully realized sequel.

Overwatch 2 simply exists in an awkward transition phase between the game it was and the game it wants to be. It's not a revolution by any stretch, at least not how the original game was, but it's still Overwatch and that means it's still a ton of fun.

It’s difficult to look back on a game like Overwatch and wonder what it could’ve been if it had been delayed, and released as a complete, full-priced package with none of the extras: no feel-bad Battle Passes, with the story mode and Hero Missions available to all from the get-go. It’s not all doom and gloom of course; I’ve been in denial about the change in direction for PvP, but tens of hours of

This is, really, a relaunch dressed up as a sequel, although the game remains as fun as ever. Some balancing issues and, of course, a questionable progression system hinder the potential of Overwatch 2.
Overwatch 2 is as fun and fast-paced as the original game, but its free-to-play structure sullies the experience a bit.

critic.quote: World of Tanks: HEAT is a bold reinvention of a franchise that many players probably didn't expect to see move in this direction. Turning World of Tanks into a hero shooter could have easily felt forced, but Wargaming has managed to create something that feels surprisingly natural once you're actually in a match.

World of Tanks: HEAT from developer Wargaming Group Limited is a good F2P game that offers fun modes, good customization, and a short stint of good MP matches. While the vanilla version of this game isn’t quite packed with a huge variety of modes, it still is a good way to have some dumb fun.

World of Tanks: HEAT successfully reimagines Wargaming’s classic tank warfare as a faster, more accessible tactical vehicle shooter. Its Agents, abilities and objective-based modes give the formula a welcome hero-shooter edge, although its long-term appeal will depend on balance, progression and post-launch support.

World of Tanks: Heat is a solid entry in the WoT franchise. The free-to-play model with premium paid options is a great way to bring new players into the fold and won’t risk pricing people out by costing an arm and a leg just to get started. With lots of agents and tanks to unlock and upgrade, World of Tanks: Heat is a well that will not run dry any time soon.
World of Tanks: Heat has potential rooted in fast-paced, visually impressive battles. However, right now it feels more like an open beta missing crucial and inexplicably omitted features.

World of Tanks: Heat stands out as a stylish tank shooter featuring hero classes that add depth and variety. However, the team-based gameplay across the various modes constantly oscillates between slow and tactical pursuit and fast-paced action, without ever fully committing to either.

critic.quote: Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra does not reinvent the wheel. Instead, incorporates all the engaging elements of other MOBAs on the market and delivers a highly entertaining experience with substantial challenge. It is not League of Legends with skins of Akira Toriyama's characters. It is a video game that provides all the necessary elements to offer enjoyable matches for every fan of this franchise.

Dragon Ball Genkishin Squadra, from developer Ganbarion and Bandai Namco Games, is a surprisingly solid MOBA game. It takes the Dragon Ball universe and merges it beautifully within the MOBA genre without losing the essence of the IP.

Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra is Bandai Namco’s answer to the stagnation of the MOBA genre, a title that forgoes the extreme complexity typical of League of Legends and Dota 2 in favor of a more immediate, dynamic, and accessible approach.

DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA is one of my new favourite online multiplayer games thanks to its incredibly fun and frantic large-scale battles that keep you strategising and forging ahead while taking in the awesome sights and sounds which will make any fan light up.

Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra turns a complex genre like the MOBA into an accessible and entertaining experience without losing depth in the process, while also paying tribute to Akira Toriyama’s work. Although it features a limited starting roster, few game modes, and monetization that restricts access to key content, this may very well be one of the series’ best purely online games.

Dragon Ball: Gekishin Squadra is a bold move for the franchise, venturing into the MOBA genre with a result that works and is fun to play, but still needs a bit more refinement to reach its full potential. Improving character balance, refining the interface and adding more interaction with the environments. Still, fans of the series are going to enjoy it.

critic.quote: Lamentum is equal parts frightening and enticing, serving up a scintillating world filled with Lovecraftian horrors and remnants of old school Resident Evil and Silent Hill. It is a must-play for any fans of the genre looking for challenging gameplay, deep mythos, and an alluring narrative.
Fast-paced battles for one of the most interesting battle royale games around.

With daily challenges and quests that reward you the more you play, Naraka: Bladepoint is shaping up to be game that plans for set up shop and last for a while. No two rounds feel the same, and yet the familiarity of each one makes it easy to keep coming back for more. It’s not perfect, by any means, with its combat system offering a breath of fresh air but also leading to moments of frustration.

Naraka: Bladepoint offers a refreshing alternative to both the tired sci-fi or high fantasy settings and mechanics of familiar battle royale games, with a focus on fast and skillful melee combat and movement that can feel like an awesome martial arts film come to life. But the focus almost entirely on close quarters fighting can grow repetitive and frustrating, too, especially against the much bet

Naraka: Bladepoint does have a lot of cool and unique ideas for the battle royale genre. I love its melee-focused combat, I love the varied weapon selection, and I dig the durability system replacing the "limited ammo" functions of other games in the genre. However the game's longevity suffers due to becoming stale quickly, the lack of variance in the core gameplay loop rearing its ugly head quick

Naraka: Bladepoint represents an interesting twist in the Battle Royal panorama, but it falls short in some of the core mechanics. The fluid combat system is great, but it becomes chaotic in more hectic situations. The visuals are stunning and music is on par. The business model is quite aggressive for a game that is not free to play.

critic.quote: Dead or Alive 6 is amazing. It’s the best looking fighting game out there, bar none, and has a combat system that is both instantly accessible for newcomers, without feeling condescending, and yet also offering plenty of depth and complexity for experienced fans. It’s not perfect; the story mode is enjoyable but slightly undercooked, and one suspects that we’ll have to wait until pretty deep into

Dead or Alive 6 is a mechanically solid and foundationally sound fighting game. At its core, playing matches with others is a fun and thrilling experience that’s easy to grasp if you’re new to fighters or the series. Its lack of modes, however, coupled with its small roster, and a recently revealed $92 season pass raise a lot of questions as to what ideals drove the game’s development. For those l

Dead Or Alive 6 is still a very good fighting game which allows instant fun, even for a novice player, but you'll need serious skills to defeat a seasoned player. We only regret long, loading times and a weird storyline.

Dead or Alive 6 serves up great fighting mechanics, solid offline mode variety, and looks good while doing it. If you're a fan of the series, it's well worth checking out, even as this latest entry stumbles in the online arenas and the disappointing approach to customization.

Ultimately, I’m not sure if Dead or Alive 6 is the game that fans expected after a seven-year wait, but with its thrilling combat and amazing visuals, it still serves up a fulfilling experience — fanservice and all.

Dead or Alive 6 has a lot going for it – solid combat mechanics and an incredible tutorial mode being the elements that stands out the most – but overall it feels a little too bland and lacking in content to stand out in the sea of great fighting games of yesteryear.

advantage of multi-platform crossplay.

With its genetically modified super animals and original ideas, Super Animal Royale is a fun game that we come back to regularly. critic.quote: The First Descendant offers engaging sci-fi action with stunning visuals and fast-paced gameplay, but it comes with some caveats. While the combat and world-building are strong, the experience is somewhat marred by repetitive missions and a lack of innovation. It’s a solid entry for fans of the genre, but it may leave those seeking something truly groundbreaking feeling slightly underwhelmed.
The graphics are good, the matches are very good, the variation in play style is impeccable and there is plenty to do at any time. Even though there are obvious weaknesses and a slightly greedy shop.
If you're bored of Destiny 2, you now have an alternative, albeit it's not as good.

The First Descendant does not yet feel like it could become a serious competitor to the big names in the genre. Perhaps the game will surprise us with more endgame content that will satisfy our looter-shooter needs. So far, my experience has been mixed.

The First Descendant is neither bad nor outstanding. It doesn't do anything particularly well, but it doesn't do anything insanely badly either. A mid-range shooter that is outshone by the greats of the genre.

I’m more than ready to put The First Descendant down and not come back for a while. Its character playstyles are fresh and interesting, but underbaked gimmicks, overly familiar ideas, and underwhelming encounters make it hard to recommend. 进入皇家高地，在这片广袤地区的中心探索遗失在时间长河中的远古宫殿遗迹。认识新的村民，发现独一无二的生灵植物，解开尘封在阳光明媚的美丽之地的久远秘密。
在全新的冒险中纵情驰骋
与属于自己的坐骑一起结伴跨越《Palia》的奇妙世界，每一次的骑乘冒险都将以前所未有的速度带你去领略远方的无限可能。
造访常青森林，并发现这片远古魔法森林中隐藏的秘密

与你一起成长的世界
五花八门的季节更新与庆祝活动伴随着《Palia》一同不断变化与进化。每一个季节都会带来全新的冒险、布告栏任务、社区活动、进度路线以及能够与好友共享的惊喜时刻。无论春、夏、秋、冬，全年不断的精彩内容绝对让你流连忘返。
建立长久的友谊
您能与可爱的村民们建立深厚的人际关系，也可以和其他冒险者作伴，一起踏上难忘的旅程。收集、交换可爱的玩偶、马铃薯墩墩和贴纸，并在过程中与他人结下友谊。
探索、收集、繁荣发展
漫步于基利马村、巴哈利湾、常青森林以及皇家高地，一边收集稀有昆虫、采集原料，一边欣赏帕利亚的美丽风景。悉心照料农田与花园，并过上梦想生活。
你的冒险你做主
无论是单人游玩还是结伴而行，你都能感受到帕利亚世界的好客与热情。在温馨的社区中结识新好友、学习魔法、结伴冒险并体验这个世界的无尽魅力。

While the main quests may not catch your attention too hard, the customization, exploration, and new free Elderwood expansion will be enough to motivate you to give this a shot. It still has some growing pains, but right now, Palia is a solid game.

Palia is a casual, comfortable life sim that warmly welcomes players both old and new. The game features a cast of diverse NPCs to befriend or romance and a peaceful, smooth gameplay loop where any of your activities add to your overall progression without being overbearing or stressful. The recent Elderwood expansion introduced more content and activities, but did not add anything strictly brand-

Aside from being an MMORPG and having the cooperative multiplayer element not always found in cozy life sims, Palia doesn’t really stray far from the formula. I can certainly understand gamers vibing with Palia’s gentle, appealing world. critic.quote: Although all the combos, stances and weapons make it to the small screen, the touch controls are no match for a proper controller, instantly putting mobile players at a disadvantage in the game’s all-platform cross-play matches. Brawlhalla comes to mobile at the end of an exciting journey, with millions of players and a solid eSport scene.

As much as I like Brawlhalla, I find it tremendously unsatisfying to play using a touch screen. This limits its appeal significantly, as it's only worth playing if you are ok with routinely whipping out a controller to do so. There are some other quirks to the game itself, for sure, but Brawlhalla is otherwise a surprisingly fun and focused platform fighter that is uncompromised in its mobile form

在魔法與機械共奏的浮空世界中，自由的冒險者開始探索遺跡，並發現世界的真相！在探索「古阿特蘭遺跡」的旅程中，冒險者將遇上劣化的怪物、結識各式各樣的伙伴，並一同穿越時光的帷幕，親眼見證最古老的魔法與機械軍團。隨著他們一步步深入未知，塵封的謎底將逐漸被揭曉，最終引領阿特蘭世界重獲秩序與寧靜。
■ 超爽快動作連擊 體驗花式Combo
玩家能盡情享受從地面打到空中的暢快連擊，抓準時機浮空閃避，進而發掘意想不到的驚喜，全方位建構的多維度戰鬥打擊面，在瞬息萬變的戰局中體驗一擊制敵的爽快攻擊感！清晰的受擊反應、碰撞、擊飛動作，結合環境互動與戰鬥音效所帶來的真實物理反饋，粒子碰撞加持，使技能演出更加華麗，放大戰鬥的特效與臨場感。
□ 多種職業自由選 打造你的專屬技能
遊戲開局即可自由選擇多種職業。每個職業皆擁有超過20種技能組合，為玩家提供豐富多元的搭配可能性，鼓勵玩家嘗試不同想法，打造屬於你的專屬技能。
■ 多人團本新體驗 共鬥才是通關奧義
在危險重重、迷霧重重的冒險旅途中，冒險者從不是孤身前行的！你可以與夥伴組成一支兼具實力與勇氣的冒險者團隊，並與志同道合的夥伴建立屬於自己的艦隊，在阿特蘭大陸上與眾多艦隊角逐較量，追尋「最強」之名！
□ 公平競技真對決 操作技術決定勝負
在這裡，戰鬥的勝負回歸操作與技術本身。無論是在 1V1 的排位賽單挑，還是 3V3 的團隊戰，都會維持職業平衡，以確保所有玩家在同一起跑線上展開較量。靈活走位、技能連段與時機掌握，都會成為左右戰局的關鍵。即刻開啟「靠實力說話」的熱血對決，每一場戰鬥都值得認真對待。
■ 新手入門沒負擔 超越自我永無邊界
透過直覺化的操作設計與清晰的新手引導，讓即使是首次體驗動作遊戲的玩家，也能迅速上手、使出流暢連擊。無需長時間的學習或研究數值，也能立刻感受到戰鬥打擊的爽感，享受動作遊戲的魅力。

critic.quote: If you enjoy pinball in any shape or form, Zen Pinball 2 is a must download.

The great pinball simulator we already know arrives on PS4 letting us download all the tables we've already purchased on PS3 and PS Vita versions. There's no new additions, but the experience is as good and addictive as it is on other platforms.
As it stands, the game is a fun romp, but only if you can get past the differences from real pinball psychologically.

After its enjoyable outings on previous platforms, Zen Pinball 2 has arrived on the PS4 in good form. Assuming that you can get past the inflexible purchasing options and cut through the sometimes overwhelming digital gloss, you’ll find a flipping fun game with an addictive core at its steel-coated centre.

s.desc:
《KID A MNESIA》是一个如痴如梦的空间，一座高大宏伟的建筑。它采用了 Radiohead 的《Kid A》与《Amnesiac》中的插图、生物、词汇和录音，又对这些二十年前的旧素材进行了基因突变式的改造，从而赋予了它们新的生命。
为了配合 Radiohead 的《Kid A》与《Amnesiac》中的音乐，Stanley Donwood 和 Thom Yorke 特意留下了一系列扭曲而焦虑的插图与文字，而这一切都在一座以铅笔绘制的森林里得以重现天日，化为现实。这一切会将展览的概念延展至临界点……或是将它彻底改造成别的东西。
《Kid A》和《Amnesiac》的原始多声道录音以截然不同的面目散落在一系列可能或不可能存在的空间里，而这些空间里又居住着同样可能或不可能存在的生物，包围着这一切的则是 Stanley Donwood 和 Thom Yorke 在千禧年伊始创作的艺术作品。

critic.quote: DC Universe Online is ground-breaking; it's innovative and downright addictive.
Accessible for console gamers and vital for the comic fan. If you're prepared to pay subs, get it. [Mar 2011, p.79]
Solid and captivating for old MMO hands. For new comers, not so much. [Mar 2011, p.90]

DC Universe Online is a good game, one that can appeal to both MMO and comic fans. On Consoles there's nothing better, and if you plan on playing it on a Ps3 it's well worth the monthly fee. Not so much on PC's though, where there's a lot of strong competitors, and Sony's title is a bit too repetitive and bugged to come out on top. Still, it's the best superhero themed MMO on the market and it has

An action-packed MMO, with some important flaws that must be corrected if Sony wants to appeal a vast audience. Controls can become an issue if you play it on PC and quests are a bit too much on the grinding side, but the combat system and the customization options are fun. With some improvements this game could find its own place in the MMO jungle.
But especially on the PS3, the menus and various engine bugs really make it tough to justify the initial purchase (with one free month of gameplay), much less the eventual monthly fee.

s.desc:
欢迎来到终极可爱混乱游乐场。你将化身为一只调皮捣蛋的小猫咪，目标只有一个：把每个房间都变成你个人的完全破坏游乐场。从宽敞的郊区住宅到三个独特地点的阳光充沛的院子，你可以自由地跳跃、探索，随意敲翻每一件易碎物品。
做一只猫是份繁忙的工作。要完成你的日常任务，你需要追捕狡猾的老鼠、抓坏地毯，以及进行有趣无害的恶作剧来让你的主人们时刻保持警惕。在探索过程中，你可以收集隐藏的星星并赚取金币来解锁新的高度精细化房间，扩大你的领地。为了让冒险更加有趣，你可以解锁并扮演各种可爱的动物伙伴，并用一系列搞笑、时尚的帽子来装扮它们。拿起你的控制器，无视房屋规则，向世界展示一只小猫咪能惹出多大的麻烦！

经典生存恐怖
DERELIKT的氛围与结构受到《System Shock 2》《Alien Resurrection》和《Doom 3》的启发，着重营造装备不足、身陷超出自身能力范围的困境，以及远离一切援助时的恐惧。
有什么东西苏醒了
Von Neumann Outpost是一座偏远的研究站，建造于土星轨道上一颗废弃小行星的内部。如今，这里的走廊陷入黑暗，系统不断失灵，而仅存的少数幸存者却各自讲述着不同的故事。
探索逐渐崩溃的空间站
探索前哨站的秘密、走廊、实验室、维修通道和船员舱室。深入岩石内部更加诡异的区域。搜寻补给，解决环境谜题，并在这座越深入越危险的空间站中解锁新的路线。
不要完全相信任何人
空间站上仍有十多名NPC，每个人都有自己的问题、目的，以及对事件经过的说法。有些人需要帮助。有些人知道了不该知道的事情。有些人可能有用、危险、命中注定难逃一劫，或者三者兼具。
让每一发子弹都发挥作用
战斗紧张而富有满足感，你可以使用各种传统武器和外星武器。但每一发子弹都有代价。弹药、生命值和背包空间都十分重要。你拥有足以求生的火力，却不足以让自己感到安全。这不是一款让你肆意展现力量的线性射击游戏，而是一个令人不安、诡异且充满敌意的世界。
致敬90年代末的恐怖游戏
DERELIKT致敬早期3D恐怖游戏：扭曲的几何结构、厚重的氛围，以及挥之不去的不安感。游戏忠实而精美地重现了PS1美学，包括仿射纹理扭曲、动态细分、精心手绘的顶点颜色，以及全动态CGI过场动画。

critic.quote: DERELIKT is both a great nostalgic tribute to old-school gaming and a genuinely good title that stands out on its own. The worldbuilding is excellent, the gameplay is fun despite being intentionally dated, and the horror is genuinely strong without relying on jump scares. There is very little to complain about with DERELIKT, especially if you go in knowing that it was designed to feel like it coul

DERELIKT is a fun and intense throwback to the PS1 era that combines the atmospheric horror of Dead Space with the action and exploration of Half-Life. Its terrifying alien encounters, satisfying combat, and nostalgic presentation make exploring its infested research station a thrilling experience. While frustrating puzzles, occasional crashes, and gameplay bugs interrupt the fun, DERELIKT remains

A good old-school shooter and a convincing nostalgia trip, despite a few rough edges. DERELIKT will delight anyone who grew up with the claustrophobic adventures of the late '90s, offering a campaign that remains engaging from beginning to end, even if it occasionally feels a little too straightforward. A visual treat and enjoyable to play; an impressive achievement for a solo developer.
DERELIKT captures the heart and soul of the days of early 3D gaming, almost to a fault, delivering a game that can be frustrating and fun in equal measure.

s.desc:
在这款轻松悠闲的工作模拟游戏中，吹散落叶与烦恼。经营业务，购置新工具，解锁升级，同时欣赏落叶纷飞。毕竟，一个人的垃圾是另一个人的财富。
清洁小镇
体验《Leaf Blower Co.》的完整故事，清理杂物，重现宁静祥和的世界。当然，没人指望你免费干活！用辛苦赚来的钞票购置新装备、升级，甚至新风格。工欲善其事，必先利其器。要是你不动手，谁还会替你为垃圾桶换皮肤呢？
四季皆宜的工作
吹落叶这活儿可不全是阳光彩虹——毕竟就算大雨倾盆，学校操场上的落叶也得清理；网球场上突降的暴风雪，正是考验你的吹叶机性能的好机会；虽说镇长要求日落后紧急打扫他的花园有点反常，但你又怎能拒绝？
感受内心的宁静……
圆满完成工作后，真切地感受恢复宁静带来的满足感；全神贯注，吹走所有不合时宜的杂物；漫步于一系列温馨宜人的场景中，彻底放松身心。
……并探寻所有秘密
每个场景都设有可选奖励目标和隐藏彩蛋，犒赏你对每个角落的探索。需要敏锐的观察力和熟练掌握所有工具，才能找齐它们！
随心所欲地吹叶
完成剧情模式后，自由游玩模式将满足你的吹落叶瘾。自由选择心仪的场景、理想的天气和合适的时段。从海滩上白雪皑皑的清晨，到公园里辉煌绚烂的日落，一切由你掌控。按你的方式玩转《Leaf Blower Co.》！"

critic.quote: Leaf Blower Co. feels like an early-access game that’s nowhere near ready — buggy, poorly optimized, and, maybe worst of all, shallow and painfully repetitive.

s.desc:
恭喜你，新兵！你已被选中拯救人类，免遭庞大外星机械舰队的蹂躏。你的任务？登上母舰，摧毁一切移动的物体，并活到足以向他人汇报为止。你的装备？两条完好的手臂和数量多到离谱的枪械零件。欢迎来到《母舰：锻造》，这是一款VR Roguelite射击游戏，在这里，威力更大的武器、糟糕的决策和惊人的火力都是你工作的一部分。
打造你梦寐以求的武器，或者噩梦般的武器！直接抓取、组装武器组件到你的手臂上，创造出各种机械怪物，包括链式机枪、激光枪、火焰喷射器、榴弹发射器，甚至是爆炸披萨。超过万亿种可能的组合，让你能够建造出高耸入云、多管齐下的巨兽，足以让任何一位正经的武器工程师重新考虑自己的职业。添加护盾，尝试各种特殊改装，探索那些或许根本不应该存在的组合。
当然，母舰可不会在你组装最新杰作的时候乖乖待着。在遍布机械敌人的随机战斗房间里杀出一条血路，躲避如潮水般涌来的子弹，灵活地闪避、格挡、出拳，杀出一条血路。征服四个截然不同的地形，挑战巨型 Boss，收集升级道具，解锁新组件，为下一次挑战做好准备。与好友一起加入这场混战，体验双人在线合作模式，尝试多种挑战模式，或者挑战每日任务，赢取轮换的挑战奖励和排行榜。
在 PlayStation VR2 上体验机械狂潮！享受原生 120 FPS 的游戏体验（无需重投影），体验眼动追踪注视点渲染、头戴式触觉反馈（让你感受到击打的冲击）以及带有自适应扳机的 Sense 控制器反馈，让你的武器库栩栩如生。PlayStation Network 好友邀请、内置语音聊天功能以及包含白金奖杯在内的完整奖杯列表，众多挑战正等待着勇敢的玩家加入。
人类正指望着你呢。现在就去创造一些惊世骇俗的杰作吧。

critic.quote: Mothergunship: Forge delivers a clean roguelite experience, with a snappy loop, an innovative spin on its genre, and fun gunplay. It's not the biggest game on the Quest — let alone in its genre — but what it lacks in content, it makes up for in fun.
Overall, Mothergunship: Forge comes out of the gate strong and gets more fun with each subsequent run.

Wear the headset and start shooting. And dodging. And creating absurd weapons. MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE is a pretty straight-forward roguelite shooter that delivers on its premise. It won’t do much more than that, but that’s fine, believe me.

MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE is a lot of fun. One of the best VR bullet-hell games I’ve experienced, it will have you ducking, bending and swiveling like a demon. It may lack variety and is best played in small doses (and big clear rooms), but If you like bullet-hell survival, and you’ve got a Meta Quest 2, this one is a title to check out.

While a different game from its prequel, Mothergunship: Forge is a great arena shooter with a strong challenge level.  It takes practice to get past that first boss and into the more ornate areas, but along the way you’ll unlock perks and new weapon parts to help each run get farther into the heart of the ship.  As the rooms get bigger the amount of area to keep track of grows as well, requiring y

Mothergunship: Forge is a classic wave shooter just like Blasters of the Universe, taking the ability to swap out weapon components to a whole new level. The variance in parts is almost like stepping into a Lego store to build your ideal model. Get far enough and the guns can get ridiculous, filling the screen with components. Then again, that’s kind of the point. It would’ve been nice to have a s

users.author: azuranyan

Don't let pre-conceived dislike of wave shooters get you down--this is a real win for the VR platform and stands out from the rest.

s.desc:
与朋友和猴子一起体验混乱又刺激的拆弹乐趣！三名玩家组成一支合作小队，分别扮演失明、失聪和失语的猴子。每名玩家只能获得完成任务所需的一部分信息。互相沟通、解决谜题，并与时间赛跑。你们能在炸弹爆炸前将它们拆除吗？
• 3人合作： 不多不少，恰好需要三只猴子。
• 3种游戏模式：
o 战役： 30个精心设计的关卡，难度逐步提升。
o 无尽： 程序生成的波次关卡，难度不断增加。
o 自定义： 自由调整炸弹难度、计时器、模块类型、环境危险以及允许的失误次数，打造属于你们自己的挑战。
• 非对称角色： 每名玩家看到、听到和行动的方式都不一样。
• 趣味互动： 指指点点、挥手、做手势，或者疯狂挥舞手臂。你能做什么，只受想象力和每名玩家的表情轮盘限制。
• 扇巴掌： 显然，这是必不可少的功能。
• 全新环境： 我们都熟悉那辆可靠的小型面包车，但飞机呢？你们还能在哪些环境中拆弹？
• 环境危险： 应对停电、障碍物和嘈杂干扰等突发事件。
• 语音聊天： 有些人能说话，有些人不能。你们自己想办法吧。
• 谜题模块： 每枚炸弹都拥有不同的模块和规则，保证让你们陷入各种不同类型的恐慌。
• 关卡系统： 拆除炸弹即可解锁新关卡。你们越熟练，挑战就越困难。
• 色盲模式： 猴子看不见并不代表它不能拆弹！游戏中的物体和用户界面颜色经过调整，以支持两种不同类型的色盲。

critic.quote: Funny concept, polished mechanics, adorable graphics, and chill vibes even when everything’s about to blow. Bombanana is a blast no matter who you’re playing with or which monkey you’re playing as—as long as you have two other people to play with. Although guaranteed playability is limited by a strict multiplayer requirement and comes at three times the price, this is a one-of-a-kind co-op bomb de

Bombanana! is an original, delightfully zany, and absurdly addictive game—provided a few conditions are met: you need players who speak your language, are ready to have a good time no matter what, and are willing to accept that mistakes or misunderstandings can happen to anyone. It’s not for everyone—there are other cooperative games that don’t involve language barriers or the kind of pressure bui

The role that each monkey plays with each respectful gesture is fun because, no matter who you get, it is still enjoyable. Each new puzzle they introduce is a struggle, but studying and overcoming it is enjoyable. Overall, Friendsloop is not a cinematic game that everyone respects, but it still creates great memories. With that said, I want to give it 5/10, but the art style is different.

s.desc:
探索一个充满糖果的美丽世界。在精心设计的关卡中提升你的技巧，同时明智地收集并使用强化道具。
将三个或更多相同的糖果匹配并消除以通关，并尽可能利用特殊糖果！这款游戏带来的乐趣远超其他任何消除类游戏！
在各个关卡中收集虚拟货币（无需额外购买，靠实力赢取），并在“幸运轮”上试试手气。
《甜蜜糖果》将带给你数小时的欢乐时光！

users.quote: Terrible Candy Crush ripoff that literally got stuck in the very first game I played. One of the gems got stuck in between 2 others and the whole field couldn't move anymore. Also absolutely horrible touchscreen response. I clearly swipe up and the game swipes left. Just avoid this one. If a developer can't even make a match 3 game, they are not worth your time.

s.desc:
从小做起，但要心怀大梦想。在 **House Cleaner Simulator** 中，你将接手住宅、办公室、车间、餐厅，甚至豪华庄园的清洁工作。随着每一处表面变得闪闪发亮，你的清洁事业也会不断发展，声誉节节攀升。
**游戏特色：**
* 解锁全新的拖把、高压清洗机、海绵以及其他专业工具
* 清洁更加豪华的场所，赚取名声与财富
* 提升角色等级，接手更具声望的合同
* 升级总部，扩大你的公司规模
* 获取新的工作车辆，接触更大型的客户
* 成为全城最出名的清洁达人！
无论是擦洗地板，还是用高压水流冲走顽固污垢，每一份工作都会让你离成为终极清洁大亨更近一步。**House Cleaner Simulator** 不只是一款游戏——它是一款完整的清洁事业模拟器，带来令人满足的游戏体验和无尽的成长空间。
拿起你的拖把，踏上登顶之路吧！

critic.quote: Cleaning is not a popular activity, but it works well on computer screens. But certainly not in this game.

s.desc:
Cats with Guns 是一款融入轻度肉鸽元素的 2D 休闲游戏。你可以在战斗中做出策略决策，让一只小猫咪成长为强大而威风的战士。强化你的猫咪，运用强力技能击溃敌军。凭借猛烈火力迎战数量庞大的敌人，逐一击败敌方将领，最终抵达喵托邦。
故事发生在喵托邦城郊。猫咪们曾在这里幸福生活，直到老鼠大军入侵，迫使它们背井离乡。如今，一群坚定的猫咪组成了“九命旅团”，誓要从鼠群手中夺回家园。你将穿越一波又一波敌人，最终迎战老鼠入侵军的首领。

奈菲莉娅从长达3000年的沉睡中苏醒。为了通过试炼、晋升为神，她必须逃出金字塔。但考验远不止于此：她收集到的宝藏和遗物将决定最终的命运。如果宝物足以证明她的资格，她就能成为掌管财富与幸运的女神，从此享尽荣华，化身好运的象征；否则，等待她的只有永恒的不幸与苦难。她的命运由你决定。
举起雕刻精美的石块，用念力让它们在空中移动，为自己搭建跨越尖刺、深坑和箭矢陷阱的道路。每间密室都是精心设计的谜题，考验你的平台跳跃技巧与智慧。找到隐藏的出口，继续深入金字塔。别忘了搜寻宝藏，以免迎来糟糕的结局。

m.title: Nefiriya and the Sands of Eternity

s.desc:
《Deadly Stakes》是一款暗黑风格的第一人称Roguelite游戏，其中赌博机制已成为一场致命医学实验的一部分。
你是一名被关在精神病院里的病人。为了获得出院许可，你必须经历一项又一项的“治疗”：操作诡异的赌博机、偿还不断累积的债务，并设法生存下来。
规则很简单：玩游戏、赢钱，并按时偿还债务。
听起来很简单。
直到你注意到天花板上的尖刺。
每一轮游戏起初都显得公平。转动老虎机、掷骰子、收集药丸，并逐渐将这些游戏机转化为为你效力的系统。购买奇特的医疗增强剂，改变赔率，提高派彩，触发重复激活，并将各种效果串联成能够彻底打破游戏平衡的连锁反应。
在这里，运气仅仅是起点。
你玩得越久，你的build就越强大——但你的债务也会随之增长。
《Deadly Stakes》特色：
两种不同类型的赌博机——老虎机和骰子游戏——各自拥有独特的规则和升级系统。
Roguelite 式奔跑，风险随你的实力增长而增加。
丰富多样的组合与协同效应，打造真正“破局”的build。
可反复获取并强化实验性能力。
两种相互关联的资源：金钱用于生存，药丸用于变强。
多个房间由统一的经济体系和共同目标联结在一起。
老旧精神病院令人窒息的氛围、医疗官僚体系以及强制性治疗程序。
《Deadly Stakes》并非一款赌博游戏。
头奖不会让你致富。
它只会为你争取到一点点时间。

帝国将陨是一款设定在柴油朋克世界中的回合制战术游戏。升级你的军队，指挥你的部队，然后利用地形，通过强大的力量和锐利的战术消灭敌人。
黑色帝国与蓝色联盟之间正在进行一场伟大的战争。这两个超级大国长期以来为统治权而斗争。在这款回合制战术游戏中控制任意一方，发起攻击，击溃对手！
受到经典作品的启发，《帝国将陨》采用基于网格的地图，操作简单易学。通过战略性地移动单位利用地形优势。选择你的立场——你会加入好战的黑色帝国，还是支持蓝色联盟的圣战？
特色：
- 非随机战斗。
- 多种单位类型，从坚韧的步兵到强大的坦克。
- 挑战你的战术技能的强大头目战。
- 热座多人游戏，支持在一台设备上挑战好友。
- 三个故事战役，包含手工设计的关卡，确保你需要智谋与力量并用才能成功。
- 可升级单位，具备特殊技能和弱点。

三只饥饿的山羊和一个坏脾气的山怪。三只小猪和一只呼呼吹气的大灰狼。还有一个好奇的小女孩，跟着一只金色蝴蝶来到三只熊的小木屋。
Story Time 是一款温馨的游戏，收录多部经典童话。每个故事都由手绘纸板木偶在玩具剧场里像电影一样精彩上演，并为孩子朗读全文；演出结束后，还有学习游戏和自然拼读等着孩子。
首发三个故事
Three Goats Gruff（三只山羊嘎啦嘎啦）、Three Little Pigs（三只小猪），以及加入原创情节的 Goldilocks and the Three Bears（金发姑娘和三只熊）：一只金色蝴蝶把金发姑娘带到小木屋，第二天她回来道歉，还修好了熊宝宝的椅子。
一起讲故事
每个故事都有完整配音，每个角色都有自己的声音。朗读时文字会逐一亮起，点一下任何单词就能再听一遍。孩子轻点屏幕来帮忙讲故事：帮山羊过桥，帮大灰狼吹气，陪金发姑娘尝尝粥、试试椅子和床。每一页还藏着一位小伙伴等你发现。
温馨的游戏室
菜单是一间小小的游戏室：放满故事书的书架、装着学习游戏的玩具箱、做自然拼读作业的书桌，还有奖杯柜。
学习游戏
每个故事都有记忆配对、故事问答、故事排序、比大小和单词游戏，还有一个动手搭建游戏：拼个山怪（Build a Troll）、盖座房子（Build a House）和煮锅粥（Make the Porridge）。每个游戏都有简单、中等和困难三个难度。
英语自然拼读
按教学顺序学习英语自然拼读（合成拼读法）的全部46个音。点一下就能听到读音，练习拼读和组合故事里的单词，看着单词收藏册一点点填满。
贴纸和奖杯
每个故事都有自己的贴纸册（Sticker Book）可以收集，一路上还能赢得奖杯。
照顾每位读者
易读字体、更大的文字和按钮、高对比度文字、更柔和的动画，所有说明都会朗读出来。
更多故事即将到来
更多故事正在路上，包括圣诞故事 The Night Before Christmas 和 The Elves and the Shoemaker，将作为追加故事推出。
无广告。本体游戏不含游戏内购买；追加故事另行单独销售。
请注意：本游戏为英文版（英式英语旁白、屏幕文字和自然拼读课程）。

店铺管理
设计您的店铺，兼顾效率与美观。规划商品陈列位置，管理货架布局，确保顾客享受流畅的购物体验。
补货管理
通过游戏内电脑下单采购。拆箱整理货物，将其分类存放于仓库，并摆放在货架、冷藏柜及冷冻柜中。
收银服务
扫描商品、处理现金与信用卡支付，确保顾客对购物及结账体验满意而归。
动态市场
应对实时市场的复杂变动。趁价格低谷采购商品，制定最佳售价以平衡顾客满意度与利润空间。
发展壮大
积累利润后可考虑再投资。扩建店铺空间，升级内部设施，持续适应零售业不断变化的需求。
个性化定制
打造独一无二的店铺。定制地板、粉刷墙面、设置分类标识等。
全城配送
并非每位顾客都会亲临门店。接收线上订单，打包商品，亲自完成配送。
采购本地市场
厌倦支付运费或四处寻找折扣？前往本地市场发掘最优货源。
清洁维护
让店铺焕然一新。擦拭地板、清运垃圾、擦亮窗户，保持环境一尘不染。
安全防护
并非每位访客都是顾客。安装监控摄像头与警报传感器，或雇佣保安人员防范偷窃行为。
多人协作
《超市模拟器》支持最多四位好友组队经营店铺。实时协作补货上架、接待顾客、处理网购订单、管理配送并拓展市场。从驾驶货车到清洁维护、定价策略，团队协作是打造成功超市的关键。
在《超市模拟器》中，每个决策都至关重要。你能否把握机遇，在平衡顾客满意度与财务状况的同时，将普通店铺打造成零售业巨头？

critic.quote: Supermarket Simulator is a Game Pass title that is oddly addictive. If you like sim games and playing with friends, this will tick many boxes. Although it is dated, I liked the core elements and the simple mechanics.

Supermarket Simulator is incredibly addictive, which is the hallmark of any good simulation game. It has that powerful “let me do just one more shopping day” appeal to it that could, and probably will, consume a hell of a lot of your time. Yes, it is a bit rough around the edges, but the core playability and the undeniable drive to make your supermarket the best in the neighbourhood are something

Grocery retail may seem like an odd subject for a sim game, but Supermarket Simulator absolutely pulls it off. It's seriously satisfying to see your store go from strength to strength, though it's a tad frustrating you can't delegate ordering.

s.desc:
建造、定制并经营你的梦想影院！安排电影场次、售卖门票、供应美味小吃，让顾客满意而归。拓展业务、升级设备，将一家小影院发展成娱乐帝国！
一起玩更精彩！
与好友组队，体验最多支持8名玩家的多人模式！分工合作，打理日常运营，一起经营影院。
掌控全场！
挑选影片、设定票价、雇用员工、升级设备并扩建影院。每个决定都很重要！
小吃与街机乐趣！
制作爆米花和棉花糖，然后稍作休息，与好友一起畅玩街机小游戏！
打造专属风格！
用家具和装饰自由定制你的电影院，打造心目中的完美影院。
认识猫咪！
可爱的猫咪在影院里四处闲逛！抚摸它们、为它们取名，享受它们的陪伴。
---
建造它、定制它、经营它、享受它——和朋友一起！
准备好掌控全场了吗？

穿越数十年时光，装饰芭比梦幻屋™，体验这场兼具舒适与创意的冒险，畅玩经典芭比游戏。进入《Barbie™ Rewind》的世界，你将在精美的像素艺术和复古风格中重温标志性的芭比时代。好闺蜜芭比邀请你进入她的世界，并委托你翻新她的梦幻屋。从芭比超过65年的历史长河中挑选各色物品，打造独特的风格。
从三种复古设计中为梦幻屋挑选外立面、墙壁和地板，你甚至可以在不同房间之间混搭。游戏中更有一系列从历年真实芭比玩具套装中汲取灵感的精美家具、装饰和配饰，帮助你为每个房间注入独特的风格。从经典的粉色梳妆台到90年代的充气椅，在梦幻屋中充分展现你独树一帜的风格与创意。
芭比还把她从1991年到2007年的16款芭比电子游戏收藏留给了你，其中包括《Barbie™Pet Rescue》、《Barbie™ Horse Adventures™: Blue Ribbon Race™》以及从未发行过的《Barbie: Vacation Adventure》。玩遍所有游戏，完成额外任务，解锁更多物品。
许多熟悉的朋友（肯、特蕾莎和克里斯蒂）也会来造访，请你帮忙为他们也设计一番。你还可以在精美的数字版时尚鉴赏画册中翻阅芭比的历史篇章。
游戏特色
- 装饰梦幻屋！多种多样的家具、装饰和配饰从历年芭比玩具套装中汲取灵感，丰富的选择供你布置芭比的梦幻小屋。
- 表达自我。超过250件家具、装饰和配饰可供解锁，拥有无穷可能。
- 畅玩16款经典芭比游戏。
- 芭比来电！她会引导你进行游戏，定期发布游戏更新与新任务。
- 独家数字版时尚鉴赏画册。翻阅芭比的历史篇章，了解最具标志性的梦幻屋和玩具套装背后的故事。

critic.quote: Featuring 14 classic Barbie games from the 90s and 00s, this is a solid and sizeable trip down memory lane – even if many of the games don't exactly stand the test of time. Like all Digital Eclipse collections, though, this has been nicely curated with plenty of extras – the all-new 'Let's Decorate' game being the real highlight.

It's another great effort from Digital Eclipse, and I think going the extra mile with the DreamHouse really lifts the whole thing. If you're nostalgic for Barbie games or are just curious about their history, this is a lovely way to experience them.

s.desc:
你把猫带去了工作地点。这可不是个好主意：半个超市的东西都散落在地上，每个货架都空了，而明天一早店铺就要开门。所以，卷起袖子干活吧。
捡起并上架
你要在超市里穿梭，从地上捡起商品并把它们放到对应的货架上：水果和蔬菜、饮料、冷冻食品、宠物用品、书籍等等。每上架一个正确的商品都会获得金钱，每填满一个货架格都会获得经验值。
技能
你可以在平板上购买技能，让工作更轻松：更强的携带能力、为你显示对应货架的货架查找器、把对应商品送到你身边的补货，或者 Dunk Shot，让你扔出的商品在命中正确货架时自动归位。
贴纸
每次升级时，你都可以为自己的收藏册从两张贴纸中选择一张。它们会带来金钱、更短的冷却时间或更长的技能持续时间。总共有十张可以收集。
猫咪
它会在店里闲逛，让你抚摸，还会时不时说一些几乎没一句是真的猫咪冷知识。与此同时，店长鲁迪·货架会给你发电子邮件，告诉你他对猫的看法。
没有时间压力
这里没有时钟，也不会失败。把商品放错货架不会有惩罚，只是不会计数。你的进度会被保存，你想什么时候继续都可以。而当最后一件商品回到它的位置时，你就能开店，并拿到一张列出你全部成绩的小票。

加入德国交通警察，在一个完全可驾驶的开放世界中维护道路安全：无限速高速公路、蜿蜒乡村公路和热闹的小镇。在 Autobahn Police Simulator 4 中，你将以前所未有的深度体验警察日常工作。开展交通拦截、保护事故现场，并在嫌疑人逃跑时展开追捕。
驾驶各种警用车辆在完全可驾驶的开放世界中巡逻，从标准巡逻车到便衣车辆一应俱全。设有休息站和加油站的高速公路与工业区、住宅区以及藏匿于森林和山间的小城镇交相辉映。
无线电呼叫响起，你来决定如何应对。无论是例行拦截、事故救援还是警灯鸣笛的高速追逐：每一次出警都带来新的挑战。依法执勤、出色完成任务可以积累声望、晋升警衔，并解锁新的车辆、装备和警察局。
Features:
■ 近距离体验德国交通警察的日常
■ 广阔的开放世界：高速公路、乡村公路、工业区和住宅区
■ 交通拦截并检查证件和车辆
■ 种类丰富的出警任务和无线电调度
■ 特殊行动和可选支线任务
■ 多个可解锁的警察局
■ 多种警用车辆，包括便衣车辆
■ 含可解锁内容的声望与进度系统
■ 改进的画面和更真实的驾驶物理效果

扫描与检查
你的主要任务是判断谁能进入俱乐部、谁不能。客人们会排队等候，你需要根据特定标准决定是否放行。有些客人可能会试图夹带违禁物品，找出这些隐藏的物品就靠你了。使用金属探测器、扫描仪等各种工具检查客人，揪出一切可疑之处。
清洁访客
给访客洗澡、去除纹身、泼水！
打造时髦发型
剪发、剃须，甚至还能让头发长出来！
买卖物品
游戏内设有商店，你可以购买新物品和工具，让游戏更加有趣。这些升级将帮助你提升安保技能，让工作更轻松。随着关卡推进，难度不断提升，你将面对更复杂的情况和更艰难的抉择。
尽情玩乐
对访客使用大量有趣又酷炫的道具，尽情享受吧！《I Am Security》考验的是你的快速反应和对细节的敏锐洞察。你能识破捣乱分子、守护俱乐部的安全吗？立即开玩，一探究竟！

Little Kite 是一款剧情向点击式冒险游戏，配有手绘画面与氛围音乐。故事围绕玛丽和年幼的儿子安德鲁展开，讲述一个家庭面对家暴与酗酒问题的经历。
扮演两位角色，探索残酷的现实与安德鲁的幻想世界，解开各式谜题。玛丽必须作出一个勇敢的决定，改变母子二人的生活。
游戏文字语言：英语、乌克兰语、荷兰语、俄语。无配音。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: Whilst Little Kite is certainly a worthwhile experience, it must be said that localisation isn’t a strong point with numerous grammatical issues including misspelt words and missing punctuation, but it certainly isn’t any reason not to jump into this fantastic story.

Little Kite will take you around 4 to 5 hours to complete, maybe less if you're clever and nail the puzzling situations. It’s a well created experience, and is great to see something tackle new and fervent ground in its subject matter. The artwork is amazing and the world created brilliantly realised, however the controls feel awkward at times and the speed of the cursor is annoying.

s.desc:
一款采用手绘美术的剧情向点击式冒险游戏。
惯犯 Oliver 因自己对家人造成的伤害而深感悔恨。他试图修复与前妻的关系，却屡屡失败，处境和对酒精的依赖也随之恶化。
一天，他在一家小商店目睹一名年轻女子实施抢劫。他看到了帮助他人、弥补过错的机会。但究竟谁需要帮助，谁才是受害者？
探索充满氛围的手绘场景，解开谜题，体验结局出人意料的故事。Repentant 部分延续了 Little Kite 的故事，但不了解 Little Kite 也可以游玩。
游戏内文本：英语、俄语、乌克兰语和荷兰语。语音：英语。游戏不支持中文。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: Although it sports some incredible artwork and a few interesting plot twists, Repentant doesn’t come close to achieving the heights of its predecessor, Little Kite.

s.desc:
《安全之地》是一款引人入胜的社交点击冒险游戏，深入探讨了童年的残酷现实和自我牺牲的复杂性。作为《小风筝》和《忏悔》创作者三部曲的第三部作品，这款游戏带领玩家踏上一段穿越命运羁绊角色生活的情感之旅。
故事发生在90年代初严峻经济危机中的后苏联城市，讲述了普通工程师亚历山大和有着坎坷过去的12岁女孩克里斯蒂娜的故事。一时的疏忽导致亚历山大意外杀人，而克里斯蒂娜成为唯一目击者。为了逃避后果，亚历山大隐瞒了罪行，并说服克里斯蒂娜保持沉默。作为交换，她要求他帮助解决自己的问题。从互惠互利的协议开始，迅速演变为一个充满道德抉择和意想不到后果的扣人心弦的故事。
游戏玩法融合了经典的点击解谜和戏剧性的情节反转，创造了一个强大的叙事体验，让玩家在同情与愤怒之间经历情感过山车。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: The Safe Place is a compelling, expressive interactive tragedy. It contains an engrossing story brought to life by well-executed writing, graphics, music, and puzzles that will arouse the emotions of its players.

The gritty, realistic urban setting is stunning, but the story of The Safe Place is so drearily centered on poverty, crime and abuse that succeeding in cracking the more difficult inventory puzzles becomes more of a struggle than a pleasure just to progress and see more misery unfold.

s.desc:
踏入动荡的裂隙，在异界怪物的虎视眈眈下死里逃生，搜集各类诡秘原料，供给藏于英国酒吧地下的隐秘酿酒工坊。《危险等级》是一款支持1-4人游玩、物理驱动的合作生存恐怖游戏。越深入裂隙，越发怪诞诡异。切记，务必在酒吧打烊前赶回来。
1-4人联机生存，支持近距离语音
既可单人闯关，也能与至多三名好友共同直面裂隙中的重重恐怖。团队协作是生存关键，但活下去从来没有保证。游戏内置近距离语音聊天。
程序生成的裂隙次元
每一次远征，体验都截然不同。每一处裂隙都会生成全新生态区域、不断变化的地形布局、随机触发的危机，还有步步升级的致命威胁，逼迫整个小队随机应变。
基于物理的搜刮玩法
装备重力拳套，可一次性抓取、搬运、抛掷多件物品。采集裂隙孕育的奇异原料，前往裂隙站点换取报酬，同时还要躲避在各个次元四处游荡的恐怖怪物。
酿造特调饮品
辛苦工作一天后，带着异界原料回到布鲁巨龙的秘密酿酒坊，酿造各式饮品。完成订单，不断改良配方，提升饮品的效力。有些能赋予你强大的能力……另一些则会引发彻底的混乱。
为生存而战
每个次元都潜伏着骇人的怪物。观察它们的行为，摸清它们的弱点，巧妙运用武器，在致命遭遇中求得生机。判断何时迎战，何时保持距离。
裂隙扫描与传送门技术
使用先进裂隙扫描仪定位维度异常，部署裂隙稳定装置，撕裂开启极不稳定的传送门。迈步穿越，揭晓门后等待着你的未知存在。
狐穴酒馆
你的大本营是一间地道英式酒吧，“家族”的秘密研发设施就隐匿于此。远征间隙，你可以更换角色外观、调配增益特饮、查阅任务情报，或是往点唱机投币放松片刻。但千万别招惹酒馆老板。

《索尼克》降临《PICO PARK》！
《PICO PARK》系列是一款多人合作动作解谜游戏，而本次最新作《SONIC PICO PARK》将与SEGA经典作品《刺猬索尼克》展开联动！
《SONIC PICO PARK》是一款需要玩家彼此合作、共同闯关的2D动作解谜游戏！
游戏规则非常简单，只要所有玩家都成功到达画面右侧的终点即可通关。不过，想要抵达终点往往需要玩家之间紧密配合。互相协助、共同破解机关，才能顺利完成关卡挑战。
本次联动作品中，所有角色都能够使用《索尼克》系列的“旋转冲刺”动作。“金环”、“环形地形”、“弹簧”等经典元素也将悉数登场，让玩家在《PICO PARK》的世界中体验原汁原味的《索尼克》风格关卡。与伙伴们携手合作，突破重重难关吧！
与历代《PICO PARK》系列作品一样，本作支持2～8人本地及线上联机游玩，所有游戏内容均可根据不同人数进行体验。同时，线上模式还支持跨平台联机，让不同平台的玩家也能一同畅玩！
无论是与家人、朋友、恋人一起游玩，还是与来自世界各地的玩家在线协作，都欢迎前来体验这款融合《刺猬索尼克》与《PICO PARK》魅力的多人合作佳作！

critic.quote: Sonic Pico Park is a charming, bite-sized cooperative experience that does justice to both TECOPARK and SEGA's beloved franchise. Its simple puzzles emphasize communication and teamwork while paying a fitting tribute to Sonic's 35th anniversary. Despite its limited scope and low difficulty, it's a delightful choice for players looking for a fun, lighthearted experience to share with friends and fa

It's hard not to look at Sonic Pico Park as more Pico Park, but with a Sonic coat of paint. That's hardly a bad thing. I had a lot of fun with it, even if the fun was over quickly. It's a pick-up-and-play game, easy enough for anybody to get into without need for explanation. If anything, I'm slightly disappointed that there isn't more of it, because the Sonic the Hedgehog accoutrements add a lot

Sonic Pico Park is a delightful little puzzle game that blends quick, addictive multiplayer puzzles with a simple, charming aesthetic. I wish it had some single-player content, but playing with others is so fun that it makes the game worthwhile on its own.

Sonic Pico Park is a step up for the iconic puzzle-platformer. It adds a sense of style and quick-thinking that only Sonic could bring to Pico Park while giving an element of chaos not entirely new to Sonic, but elevated through the humor of Pico Park. The dedication and love to the Sonic series can be felt in everything it squeezes into its short run time, as well as how every single character’s

Sonic Pico Park is a fun and simple platform game to enjoy with friends and family. It's not challenging, making it perfect for relaxed sessions, especially with more casual players. However, the lack of a single-player mode and the game's length are two noticeable problems.

Sonic Pico Park is an intriguing crossover of two distinct concepts that, against all odds, just work together. It serves up the hilarious, chaotic challenges of Pico Park powered by the iconic characters, mechanics, and quirks of Sega's flagship franchise. While the content package feels a bit light on its own, the real fun kicks in the moment you jump into multiplayer.

s.desc:
结合了“指令PRG”×“双六”的恶魔般派对游戏！
为了夺回被“双六大魔王”占领的双六乐园，最多4人在地图上转动数字前进，在各种事件和战斗中获得胜利。
与伙伴同心协力打倒强敌“四天王”和“双六大魔王”！
……但是，能在游戏中获得胜利的，只有把打倒的头目带回来的那个人。
从打倒头目的瞬间开始，伙伴就变成对手。
要合作？还是背叛？最后展现胜利笑容的会是谁？
来吧，背叛派对开始了！

editions.name: 全民丢丢乐！普利尼双六大冒险

critic.quote: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! presents a hyper-specific gameplay formula that combines strategy RPG gameplay within a co-op board game so not everyone will click with it but those who do will have an absolutely wonderful time powering-up their characters, dood.
Prinny Party: Going Overboard! is a fun and chaotic time. Adding computer players adds another layer, as they seem to hate you making any progress.

Prinny Party: Going Overboard! has refreshing ideas and pleasant enough presentation, but the lack of a traditional online multiplayer mode really hurts its appeal. If you’ve got local pals who you can play with, you’re likely to have a great time messing with each other and taking on some iconic characters from throughout the main series, but otherwise, it’ll require a bit more patience than you

While there is a solidly-designed game at the center of Prinny Party!, both the presentation and amount of content are sorely lacking for its price point. Devoted Disgaea fans may find a party game worth the cover charge, but those who would quickly tire of a single board with only a few basic gimmicks may want to search elsewhere.

s.desc:
走进 Bulb Boy 奇妙又诡异的世界。两部广受好评的恐怖冒险作品首次合而为一，尽在 Bulb Boy Anthology。
认识 Bulb Boy：一个小小的发光英雄，脑袋可以拆下来，家人个个古怪，而且总是倒霉地被怪物包围。
在初代 Bulb Boy 中，可怕的黑暗吞噬了 Bulbhouse。Bulb Boy 从噩梦中醒来，发现家人失踪、家园被怪诞可怖的生物占领。探索房屋，解开奇异谜题，揭露令人不安的秘密，并利用 Bulb Boy 的特殊能力让光明重返家园。
接着在 Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair 中继续故事。Grandparaffine 派 Bulb Boy 去地下室寻找一罐珍贵的果酱，但一件无辜的小差事很快再次滑向疯狂。黏糊糊的果冻怪、扭曲谜题、恶心惊喜，以及一个对 Bulb Boy 脑袋格外感兴趣的恐怖生物，都在等着你。
Bulb Boy Anthology 将经典点击式冒险、解谜与恐怖元素，与超现实喜剧和极具辨识度的卡通风格融合在一起：怪诞、搞笑、恶心、迷人，偶尔还会让人毛骨悚然。
两部完整冒险
一次体验 Bulb Boy 与 Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair。 一路跟随 Bulb Boy，从 Bulbhouse 的黑暗走向其地下更加怪诞的深处。
美得恶心
独特的视觉世界汲取经典动画与 1990 年代卡通灵感，充满表情丰富的角色、离奇怪物和精心打造的恶心细节。 超现实环境让这个世界更加怪诞。
动动脑袋。字面意义上的。
Bulb Boy 的灯泡脑袋可以照亮黑暗、承受电击，甚至能从身体上拧下来，用来解决游戏中最怪异的问题。
谜题、怪物与秘密
探索非同寻常的环境，解决直观谜题，对抗可怕生物，并揭开 Bulb Boy 世界中隐藏的秘密。
没有对白的故事
动画表情、视觉叙事与 Bulb Boy 独特的气泡语言，无需传统对白也能让这个怪诞世界鲜活起来。
可爱。诡异。彻头彻尾的 Bulb Boy。
黑色幽默、恐怖、荒诞与意外的温情碰撞在一起，构成两段令人难忘的独立冒险。
找到你心中的光。
媒体对 BULB BOY 系列的评价
“几乎在每个方面都表现出色的绝佳游戏。”
— Adventure Gamers
“这款小型独立游戏确实是一颗宝石。”
— GamingTrend ★ 85/100
“风格异常鲜明的作品。”
— Rock Paper Shotgun
“迷人又古怪……依旧保持出色水准。”
— Nindie Spotlight ★ 8.1/10

《REZON》是 ALLUMER 于 1991 年发售的一款射击游戏。
外星人入侵期间，玩家将在地球上控制一艘配备 VAWS（Variable Armor & Weapon System）的 SR-91 战斗机并与入侵者作战。
拾取物品并装备武器，这是一项关键功能，可让您在使用得当时从身后攻击或阻挡敌人的射击。
《Arcade Archives》系列秉承忠实复刻经典街机游戏的理念开发，并搭载了难度与画面设置、回溯功能、连发模式及多存档位等便捷特性。玩家还可通过在线排行榜与全球玩家竞逐最高分数。
《Arcade Archives 2》在系列原有的“ORIGINAL MODE”、“HI SCORE MODE”、“CARAVAN MODE”基础上，新增“TIME ATTACK MODE”模式。在“TIME ATTACK MODE”中，玩家将不计分数全力竞速通关。新增的VRR（可变刷新率）支持功能，更能还原接近街机原版的流畅体验。
请尽情享受这些标志性的街机游戏吧！它们定义了一个时代，尽在“Arcade Archives”系列！

《SHOT RIDER》是SEIBU KAIHATSU公司于1985年推出的一款竞速游戏。
玩家将操控主角驾驶摩托车，在冲向终点线的途中撞击敌方车手将其淘汰。
赛道沿途设有岔路口，根据你的选择，可以体验高速公路、岩石路段和雪地赛道等多种赛道。
请注意避开汽车和障碍物，因为撞上它们会大幅消耗你的燃料。
《Arcade Archives》系列秉承忠实复刻经典街机游戏的理念开发，并搭载了难度与画面设置、回溯功能、连发模式及多存档位等便捷特性。玩家还可通过在线排行榜与全球玩家竞逐最高分数。

*选项菜单和手册有日语，英语，法语，德语，意大利语和西班牙语。

*本游戏仅包含日语版。请注意，游戏内所有文字均为日语。
*选项菜单和手册有日语，英语，法语，德语，意大利语和西班牙语。
《Nobunaga Oda den》KOEI于1998年面向32位家用游戏机平台发行。
这款模拟角色扮演游戏生动再现了Nobunaga——这位开启日本近现代时代的伟人——的辉煌一生。
体验历史考据严谨的战斗场景，包括Okehazama之战、Inabayama之围以及Nagashino之战。
分支剧情系统：您选择的战术和战斗结果将引导历史走向不同的发展路径。
22位关键人物登场，包括Oda氏族成员、各诸侯国军阀以及文化名流。
通过分析情报并执行精准的战略来指挥盟军……
……尽情享受让《Nobunaga Oda den》栩栩如生的丰富游戏元素吧！
Nobunaga能否逃离Honno-ji的熊熊烈火，并最终结束Sengoku时代？
“Console Archives”系列秉承忠实复刻经典理念，将各代家用游戏主机上的杰作搬上现代平台，让玩家轻松畅玩。
本系列配备丰富便捷功能：支持自定义按键布局与画面设置，并可随时保存/加载进度。
无论您是昔日玩家还是初次体验，敬请尽情享受这些塑造家用机游戏历史的经典之作！

你曾坐在沙发上看新闻,对着电视骂骂咧咧,然后决定自己来干得更好。现在你有了一张办公桌、一支笔,还有一座对你抱有期待的小镇。
《Good President Simulator》是一款讽刺政治模拟游戏,以第一人称坐在办公桌前进行。法案落在桌上,访客带着各自的人情上门,而你签下的每一份文件,都会出现在明天的报纸上。
签字。或者不签。
每项法案都以纸质形式送来。拿起笔画下你的签名即可批准,或者驳回并把它揉成一团。每项法案都会用绿色和红色显示哪些阵营欢呼、哪些阵营暴怒,以及它对党的资金和公共资金造成的影响。没有哪项法案是免费的。
十五个阵营,只有一个你
社会主义者、资本家、环保人士、年轻人、安全部队、黑手党、阴谋论者等等。他们之间的友谊与仇恨彼此牵连,所以帮了一方的忙,就是冒犯另一方。如果整个阵营的支持度跌到零,他们会带着最后通牒来找你。把民调提高到50以上,你就能竞选下一个职位。
明天的头版
你桌上的报纸,是根据你昨天签署的内容写成的。读读他们怎么说你,然后继续工作。
一张会回应你的办公桌
访客走进来,递上法案,说出自己的诉求。有人带来雪茄、信封或礼物。拿了就等于接受。一切违法的事都靠口头解决,没有文件,也没有证据。忙完之后,关掉台灯回家。两项法案之间,揉皱的纸会扔进废纸篓,而废纸篓会替你记分。
付过钱的朋友
有人替你付了报名费。他们说自己是朋友。他们会来找你,他们背后的人也会。
从破屋到总统办公室
四个阶段:小镇、城市、大区和国家。赢下全国大选,输掉大选,被赶下台,或者落到更糟糕的地方:游戏共有21个结局,你的报纸为每一个结局都准备了头条。
承诺。签字。活下去。
游戏特色
- 第一人称办公桌模拟:笔、印章、台灯、废纸篓、铃铛和房门。
- 15个阵营,友情与恩怨交织成网。
- 四个阶段,四间不同的办公室。
- 21个结局,附结局图库。
- 完全支持DualSense无线手柄游玩。
- 45个奖杯加白金奖杯,部分为隐藏奖杯。
- 文字配有类似说话声的咕哝音效,没有配音。全程包含粗口和低俗幽默。

给植物浇水，给宠物喂食，不要关灯。
a pet shop after dark《天黑之后的宠物店》是一款用鼠标操作的恐怖冒险游戏。游戏里的你在一家小宠物店找了份奇怪的工作。店长告诉你这份工作很轻松——你所要做的仅仅是给植物浇水，给宠物喂食，然后过夜。
只须注意一件事——不论如何，都不要关灯。
特色
探索神秘的宠物店
给看不见的宠物喂食
给奇怪的植物浇水
以鼠标操作来解谜
注意
闪退是游戏的一部分。

《Thronefall》是一款极简主义策略游戏，你需要在白天建设自己的小小王国，夜晚抵御来袭之敌。加固城墙、招募单位，亲自冲锋陷阵，在经济与防御之间取得平衡，抵御源源不断的攻击者波次，守护你的要塞。
既可以快速游玩，也可以来一场防守马拉松，尽情享受流畅、可反复游玩且充满意外的塔防体验！
极简策略
• 10张地图。从群山环绕的北岩到生机盎然的野溪，逐步探索有不同地形、天气、敌人、建筑与挑战的多张地图。
• 9种可解锁武器。作为战士王者，你可以选择一样武器投入战斗，从战斧到血魔杖，应有尽有。
• 50多种可解锁特权。最多可携带5种特权以获得各种优势，还可选择变异以增加难度。
白天建设
• 用城墙、路障、神殿与塔楼守护你的王国。
• 通过房屋、桥梁、金矿、港口、磨坊与田地扩展经济。这些建筑只要能安全度过夜晚，每天清晨都会产出金币。
• 通过城堡中心、铁匠铺与皇家锻造厂研究升级。
• 利用兵营、射箭场与英雄居所组建军队。你的部队包括骑士、狂战士、弩手、火焰弓手，还有魔像与法师等特殊英雄。
夜晚防守
• 夜幕降临时，敌人便会接连来袭且越来越强，随时可能击溃你的王国。只有将敌人全部消灭，太阳才会升起。
• 木桶骑士、飞行法师、食人魔、史莱姆、黄蜂与投石机，大地危机四伏。
• 城堡中心被摧毁即代表你被打败。
• 身为国王，你需要亲临前线，守护你的小王国，直至太阳再度升起。

critic.quote: Chic, sleek, addictive, Thronefall is an artful gift to anyone who has been wanting to play a strategy game again for a long time, but who has struggled to integrate this often over-complex genre into their everyday lives. That's what makes it precious.

Thronefall has easily become my new favorite tower defense game, thanks to its solid mechanics and the absolute wealth of variety present in each aspect of the game. Countless difficulty mutations and enemies await you in this game, which gives new meaning to the word “replayability.”

Thronefall may be a minimalist strategy title, but it is big in heart and has a lot of depth to it. It is a game that is simple to play, but will challenge you at every turn. It is incredibly tough to put Thronefall down as it has that one more turn feel down to a tee. The challenge will be offputting for some, and there is a possible bug of enemies running around a wall, but other than that Thron

Thronefall pares back the usual tower defence formula into something simpler but still quite satisfying. Being forced to work with a predefined layout for your castle is a major limitation, and one that will frustrate some, but the perks and mutations system reintroduces just enough complexity to give Thronefall staying power. It also helps that the game looks great.
